Shri Venket Sharma, the author, offers the following opening prayer (mangalacharanam):
"After bowing repeatedly to Lord Venketeshwar, who has his abode on the side of the mountain called "Sheshadri" and to the most respectable Guru of mine whose grace has made me Pandit Vyankat sharma, I offer the book "Sarvarth Chintamani" as a ship to cross the Great ocean of Astrology by the people learned in the art of astrological divination. (1)
I bow to Shri Ganesh, who has the lustre like a blue Lotus and by worshipping whom all the gods easily get their desired object. (2)
May the Godess Sarasvati, who bestows on men the wealth of speech, who has her abode in the white Lotus and whose complexion is white like the Cow's milk, make my speech as her abode. (3)
May the signs Aries etc. the Planets Sun etc and others engaged in the welfare of mankind, always give me their protection. (4)

Whatever principles have been enunciated in the Natal Astrology, are equally applicable to the "Horary" Astrology. There is no difference between the two (Horary relates to chart of the heaven prepared for the moment of query). (5)

The lords of the 12 signs Aries to Pisces are Mars, Venus, Mercury, Moon, Sun, Mercury, Venus, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Saturn and Jupiter respectively. The lord of a navamsa is the same as that of the sign as stated above. (6) The idea underlying the lordship of the plantets over the signs is to state the fact that the various signs always act like the planets having lordship over them. For details regarding Navamsha. (See Shloka 11.)

Aries represents head, Taurus face, Gemini breast, Cancer heart, Leo belly, Virgo waist, Libra private parts, Scorpio rectum, Sagittarius hips, Capricorn knees, Aquarius legs and Pisces feet. The sign that is afflicted by the association etc of malefic Planets denotes trouble in the limb it represents. (7) The shloka is useful in the diagnosis of diseases of the limbs of the body. The particular limb represented by the sign, of course suffers as a result of affliction of the association or aspect on it of malefic planets. But the results would be more palpable if the lord of the sign also is afflicted. If, in addition, the house representing the limb is afflicted, the disease or injury would be more severe. If all the four factors representing a limb namely the sign, its lord, the house corresponding in number to the sign and the lord of that house are afflicted the trouble would be the severe most. The nature of trouble in the limb and its severity also depend on the severity of the affliction i.e. on the number and strength of the afflicting planets and their nature. For example, if the 5th sign and its lord, the 5th house and its lord are influenced by Rahu and the lord of the sign occupied by Rahu it would be a case of heart attack. If by Saturn and by the lord of the sign occupied by Saturn it would be a case of dyspepsia, indigestion etc. If by Mars and Ketu or by the lords of the signs occupied by Mars and Ketu, it would be a case for operation of or injury to the belly. In regard to intensity it may be added that if for example, the 12th house, lord of the 12th house sign number 12 and its lord Jupiter are all afflicted by both Mars & Ketu or by Mars as lord of the sign occupied by Ketu or by both, the feet may have to be amputated.

The sign Pisces is symbolised by two fish with the tail of one on the mouth of the other, Sagittarius by a man with the lower portion as of a horse and with bow in the hand, Gemini by a pair of man and woman, holding mace and the musical instrument-veena, Virgo by a girl in a boat, holding a fire pot in one hand and grains in the other, Libra by a man with balance in the hand, Aquarius by a man carrying on his shoulder a water pot. The traits of the rest of the signs are as denoted by their names i.e. Aries by lamb, Taurus by an ox, Cancer by crab, the sea creature of that name, Scorpio by Scorpion. (8-9)

A decante (Drikaan) consists of one third part of a sign. The first decante i.e. from degrees 1 to 10 has the same planet as its lord as the lord of the sign whose 1st decante it is. The 2nd decante from degrees 11 to 20 is owned by the planet who is lord of the sign 5th to the sign under consideration. The 3rd decante from 21 to 30 degrees is owned by the planet lord of the sign 9th to that under consideration. In even signs the lord of the first hora i.e. the first 15 degrees is Moon & of the next is the Sun, while in the case of odd signs the hora of the first half of the sign belongs to the Sun & the second half to Moon. (10)

The first Navamsha sign in the cardinal signs 1, 4, 7, & 10 is the lord of the sign itself i.e. Mars, Moon, Venus & Saturn respectively. The first Navamsha sign in the fixed signs 2, 5, 8 and 11 are the signs 9th from the sign i.e. 10, 1, 4 and 7 respectively. The first Navamsa sign in signs 3, 6, 9 & 12 are the signs fifth from the sign i.e. 7, 10, 1 & 4 respectively. (The rest follow in the order as stated in shloka-6.) (11) Since the order of the Navamsha signs is the same as in the natural order Aries Taurus etc to Pisces there is a very simple way to find out the Navamsha sign. Suppose we desire to find out the 1st Navamsha sign in the sign Gemini. Multiply the number of signs past i.e. 2 by 9. The result gives the signs past i.e. 18 or Virgo (12 plus 6) hence the first sign in Gemini would be the sign next to Virgo i.e. Libra. Example 2 Find out the sign representing the 4th Navamsha of Sagittarius. Here 8X9 = 72 plus 4 = 76 divided by 12 leaves 4 i.e. the answer & lord of 4 i.e. Moon is the lord of the 4th Navamsha of Sagittarius. We give below tables showing the signs falling in the various vargas or divisions of a sign and the lord of the signs so falling. 7

The 1st 1/12th part of a sign belongs to the sign itself & the other parts come in the order of the signs. As regards the 30th part, in the odd signs the lords of the first 5 degrees is Mars, of the 6th to 12th degrees Saturn, of the 13th to 20th degrees Jupiter, of the 21st to 25th degrees Mercury, of the 26th to 30th Venus. In the even signs the order is reverse i.e. the first 5 degrees belong to Venus, 6th to 10th to Mercury, 11th to 18th to Jupiter, 19th to 25th to Saturn & 26th to 30th to Mars. In odd signs the lord of the first 1/7th division is the lord of the sign itself & in even signs the lord of the 1st 1/7th division is the lord of the sign 7th to the sign involved. The order of the signs remaining as the natural one. This table has already been given. 9 10

In the odd signs the first 1/10th division belongs to the lord of the sign itself and in even signs the 1st 1/10th division belongs to the lord of the sign counted 9th from it. The order of signs is natural one. The lords of these divisions are the 10 dik pals (lords of directions). In the 1/16th division the lords of the divisions are the lords of the signs Aries to Pisces & then Aries to Cancer. In the sign Taurus the signs would be 5 to 12 & then 1 to 8 & so on (See the table). (14, 15)

Now we will deal with the 1/20th division etc. There are different Devis governing the various numbers of the 1/20th division. These are shown in the table for the 1/20th division. They are governed by Devis from Kali to Aparajita. (1-5)

In the 1/24th division the signs from Aries & other odd signs start with Leo. In the case of even signs these start with Cancer as shown in the table. As regards the 1/27th division the 1st 27th division of the sign Aries belongs to Aries. 2nd 27th division to the next sign & so on, till the 27th which will in this order be governed by Gemini. Hence the 1st 27th division of Taurus will be governed by Cancer & so on. In the 1/40th division, the first division in all odd signs belongs to the sign Aries; while in all even signs, it belongs to Libra, as shown in the table. In the 1/45 division, the 1st division of every movable sign belongs to Aries; the 1st of every fixed sign, to Leo and the first of every common sign, to Sagittarius. The order of the signs owned remains the natural one. (6-14) 14 15 16 19 20

In the case of the 1/60th division, the 1st and the 2nd division belongs to the sign itself, the 3rd and the 4th division belongs to the next sign(2), the 5th & 6th division belongs to the next sign i.e. to Gemini and so on as shown in the table. If a particular division is associated with a benefic Planet, the results given by the Planets are good. (15-20) 21 22 23 24

Planet with full strength such as by being in exaltation, in positive sign, but located in a malefic 1/60th division gets harmed (21)
A planet in its own sign, in kendra, in friendly sign, in positive sign, located in its own sign in the 7 vargas, in a bosom friends sign is called "uttam" (best). (22)

The ancient Acharyas and Maharshis have mentioned ten fold division of the longitudes of planets etc. They have termed the number of vargas or division obtained as "Parijat" etc. Planets which are located in bad houses i.e. 6th, 8th & 12th, in their inimical sign or in their debilitation sign or are eclipsed by the Sun or are otherwise weak by being in 'Maranavastha' i.e. in the end of a sign, destroy the good results arising out of the good vargas or divisions got by them through their longitude. (23, 24)

If in the longitude of the planet etc there are two beneficial divisions, it is called "Paarijaat". If 3, it is called "Uttam", if 4 "Gopur", if 5 "Simhaasan", if 6 "Paaraavat" if 7 "Devlok", if 8 "Amar", if 9 "Airaavat", & if 10 it is called "Vaisheshik". The results of these are different (see next shloka). (25-27)

In the case of "Airaavat" division one becomes emperor, in "Devlok" one is highly charitable, in "Paaraavat" one is king knowing all sciences & arts, if in "Simhaasan". One is the object of praise every where, in “Gopur” one is wealthy & a man of allround knowledge, if in “Uttam” one has all kinds of wealth & if in “Parijat” one is fairly rich. If the planet has the division denoting his own sign the native is famous, intelligent, and leads a confortable life. (28-31)

The duration of each of the 12 signs from Aries is two & a half ghati. Thus each sign comes twice in a day of 24 hours. This is called hora lagna. “Pranpad is the sign arrived at by converting the Ishta i.e. time elapsed from the last Sunrise to the moment of birth as the Palas & dividing the palas by 15. The result would be signs and degrees etc. These signs etc added to the longitude of the Sun if located in a movable sign gives the location point of Pranpad. In case the Sun is not located in a movable sign but in a fixed one the movable sign 9th to the one arrived at by taking Sun in a movable sign should be taken & in case the Sun occupies a common sign the sign 5th to it should be taken as containing the Pran Pada. For example supposing Sun has the longitude 9° 28° 30' & the Ishte is 2 ghatis & 16 palas the 2 ghatis & 16 palas are 136 palas, which divided by 15 gives 9 ayns & 2 degrees, which added to 9 28 30 (A movable sign) gives 19-0-30 = 7-0-30 as Pran Pada point (32). The Sun comes back two & a half Ghatis from Sagittarius. So also is the case with Moon. Mars comes only one ghati in opposite direction. Mercury comes only one ghati in opposite direction. Jupiter is 5 ghatis in opposite direction of Pisces. Venus comes after 2 ghatis from Pisces & Saturn after 1 ghatis. Rahu is 1 ghati in opposite direction from Aries. Ketu comes 7th to Rahu: The results of these positions are laid down in other works. (32-35)

The above shlokas 33 to 35 are not quite clear. Nor is it known as to where there explanation appears. Planets located in odd signs are (symbolically) given the names, “child” “boy” “youth” “old” & “dead” when occupying the degrees 1 to 6, 7 to 12, 13 to 18, 19 to 24 & 25 to 30 respectively in the occupied sign. If they are located in even signs the names for the 5 states involved are given in the reverse order i.e. “Death”, “Old”, “Youth”, “Boy” & “Child” respectively. Planets in their ruling periods give their results with a strength in keeping with the age specified (36, 37).

The synonyms of the various sign in the Sanskrit language are: Aries is called Meshaj, Vasta Pratham, kriy; Taurus is called Vrishabha, Uksha, Go, Tavari, Shukra Bham (sign of Venus) Gemini is called Mithun, Baudh, Nriyugma, Jitum, Triteeya, Cancer is called Karka, Chaandram, kuleer, chaturth, Leo is called Simha, Kanthirav, Leya, Virgo is called Kanya Pathon, Shashti, & Abala, Libra is called Jook, Vanik, Saptam, Tula, & Tauli, Scorpio is called Kaurpya, Ashtam, Vrishchik kauj, & Ali, Sagittarius is called Jaiva, Dhanu, Taukshik, chaap, Capricorn is called Aakekar Dasham, Chakra, & Makar, Aquarius is called Hridrog, Kumbha, Ghat, Pisces is called Rishph, Meena, Jhash, Antim, & Meena (38 & 41).

The first house is named as hora, tanu, (body) moorti, (complexion) udaya, (rising) shir, (head). The second is called vaag (speech), vitta (wealth), kutumba (family), eye. The 3rd is called sahotha (brother), dushchikya, gala (throat). The 4th is called shourya (bravery), karna (ears). sukha, water, bandhu (comforts, nater & friend & relatives) rasatal (nadir) hibuk (chest) veshma (residence), patal (nadir) hrid (heart), vahan (conveyance) matri (mother). The 5th is called budhi (intellect), prabhav (influence), aatmaj (son), mantra (advisory capacity), vivek (discrimination), udar (belly). The 6th is called disease, kshat (injury), ari (enemies), vysanam (addiction), chor (theft), vighana (obstacles). The 7th is called chittoth, kaam, madan (sexual urge), wife, bhrtri (husband), dadih, (curd) soup. The 8th is called ksheer (milk) gudam (gur) montra kricha (urinary trouble), goohya (hidden) randhra (bad) marana anta (death) Aayou (age). The 9th is termed as dharma (duty), daya (compassion) paitrik (father) bhagya (luck), guru (preceptor) tapas (penance) laabh (gains) shubhaarjitaani (earned merit). The 10th is termed as aagya (orders) maan (honour) dashma (tenth) karma (actions) aspad (position) kham (sky). The 11th is termed as ayam & laabh (gains). The 12th is termed as vyaya (expenditure) antya (last sign) rishpha (bad) vinash (destruction) (42-46)

Planets located in the 6th, 8th or 12th house lose their influence. So also is the case with the houses whose lords occupy these three houses. The signs Aries, Taurus, Gemini, Cancer, Sagittarius and Capricorn are called “Prishtodaya” signs i.e. Rising with their hind part and are strong in charts with night birth. Signs Leo, Virgo, Libra, Scorpio, Aquarius & Pisces are strong in birth chart for day birth. These are called. “Sheershodaya” signs i.e. those which rise with their front part. But the sign Pisces rises in both ways i.e. with fore as well as hind part. (47-48)

28 By adding 13 degrees 20 minutes to the longitude of the Sun in the birth chart we get the longitude of the space point called "dhoom". By deducting from 12 signs the longitude of dhoom we get the remainder as the longitude of the space point called "paat" or vyatipat". By deducting 6 signs from this longitude we get the longitude of the space point called "paridhi" or "parivesh". By deducting parivesh from 12 signs we get remainder as "chaap" or "dhanu" by adding 16 degrees and 40 minutes to Dhanu we get Ketu. By adding 2 signs to Ketu we get again the longitude of the Sun with which we started. (49)

The wise term the 1st, 4th, 7th & 10th houses as kendras, chatushtayas, etc. If a Planet occupies the Navamsha of the same sign in which it is located it is called "Vargottam" (a vargottam planet gives good results). (50)

The watery signs (second half of Capricorn, Aquarius and Pisces) are strong when located in the 4th house. The animal signs (Aries, Taurus and Leo), the first half of Capricorn and 2nd half of Sagittarius) are strong when located in the 10th house. The human signs (Gemini, Virgo & Libra and 1st half of Sagittarius) are strong in the 1st house and the insect signs (Cancer and Scorpio) are strong when located in the 7th house. The signs, located in the 7th house from where they get strength, are without strength. In the intermediary position their strength is proportional. (51)

Sun is in its highest exaltation in the 10th degree of Aries, Moon in the 3rd degree of Taurus, Mars in the 28th degree of Capricorn, Mercury in 15th degree of Virgo, Jupiter in 5th degree of Cancer, Venus in the 27th degree of Pisces, Saturn in the 20th degree of Libra. The mooltrikon or positive sign for the Sun is Leo; for Moon, Taurus; for Mars, Aries; for Mercury, Virgo; for Jupiter, Sagit- 29 tarius; for Venus, Libra and for Saturn Aquarius. Planets in their positive signs are very strong, only a little less than when in exaltation. (52,53) A question may be raised as to why a particular Planet gets exalted in a particular sign & degree. So far as we are aware no author has answered this question. We, however, think that this can be explained on the basis of spirituality to which astrology owes allegience being its main limb. The 10th degree of Aries falls in the asterism Ashvini whose lord is Ketu. Ketu has been declared by astrology as the "Moksha" karka i.e. the significator for salvation. The Sun is very well krown as the "Atma" in the Vedas.

Human signs (3,6,7 & 1st half of 9) are strong in birth charts of day birth. Animal signs (1,2,5 1st half of Capricorn and 2nd half of Sagittarius) are strong during the night births. Insect signs (4 and 8) are strong in the morning and evening time. The 3rd, 6th, 10th and the 11th houses are commonly called “Chaya” or “Upchaya” houses. (54) The term “Chaya” or “Upchaya” means houses that gather the traits of the planets located in them are said to be gained by the native. This is particularly true for planets in the 10th & 11th houses. For example, one gets many animals if Saturn (which denotes animals) is located in the 11th house. The author of Bhavarth Ratnakar holds (see shloka 1 under Libra lagna) that Jupiter for Libra nativities gives good wealth in his dasa even though Jupiter owns two bad houses of the horoscope. The reason is that the element of “financial gain” as upchaya house is common between these houses & Jupiter.

Mind immersed in the Atma represents the highest state of Samadhi. Nothing higher can be desired for the mind. Hence the exaltation in the asterism "Kritika". Now, why Taurus is preferred when the asterisms of Sun are available in the signs 5,6,9, & 10? The answer is that none of these four signs offer an emotional & luxurious testing gound as does the sign Taurus—the sign of the luxurious and amorous Venus. Hence the choice. Mars is exalted in the 28th degree of Capricorn in the asterism "Dhanishta" belonging to Mars himself. We know from astrology that Mars is a great martial planet. For a soldier to retain his mettle & bravery, even when surrounded by enemies in the enemy's camp, is his highest attainment. This is exactly what happens when Mars occupies Capricorn—the sign of its bitter enemy, Saturn. Hence 30 the justification for exaltation in Capricorn. The asterism of Mars, no doubt, is also available in the signs 2,3,6,7 & 11; but Mercury, the boy & Venus, the neutral can hardly test the bravery of Mars through their signs. As regards Aquarius, Mars in Capricorn is more strong than in Aquarius. In Capricorn it is near the asterism of Mars while it is near that of Rahu in Aquarius.

The house 2nd to the one occupied by the Sun in the birth chart is called “Veshi”. Chakrardha means half the circle. It may be from 6th to the 12th house or 1st to 4th & 4th to 7th constituting onehalf, Aries to Libra & Libra to Aries. (56)

The Sun & the Moon are royal or high class government officials. Mars is connected with the military. Mercury is heir apparent. Jupiter and Venus are ministers. Saturn is treated as servant. These planets give career in the sphere to which they relate. (57) How the Planets, Jupiter and Venus, perform the functions of ministers is illustrated by the Horoscope of Late Sanjay Gandhi. His Horoscope (birth 14th Dec 1946) is reproduced below. It would be observed that Venus, the minister, is lord of the house of Mantrana or ministership viz., the 5th from lagna. Similarly Jupiter, the other minister, is the lord of the 5th house from the Chandra Lagna. Both are located in the foremost kendra (10th) denoting karma. Hence the active interest that Shri Sanjay Gandhi showed in the affairs of the day to day working of the government as an advisor. Even though holding no portfolio, bears out the qualities of Jupiter & Venus as advisors to government.
Sun is the self (also body), Moon is mind, Mars strength, Mercury speech. Jupiter wisdom & comforts, Venus is Sex & Saturn represents sorrow. (58)
Sun is called Surya, Heli, Bhanumaan, Deepta Rashmi, Chandaanshu, Bhaskara, & Ahaskar. Moon is called Abja, Som, Chandramaa, Sheet Rashmi, Glau, Mrigaanka, Kala Ish (Kalesh). (59)

Mars is called Aar, Vakra, Aavaneya, Kuja, Bhauma, Kroora, Lohitaanga, Papi.
Mercury is called Vit, Gya, Saumya, Bodhana, Chandraputra, Chaandri, Shaanta, Shyaamgattra, Atideergha (60).

Jupiter is called Jeeva, Angira, Devguru Prashaanta, Vaachaang pati, Ijya, Diveshvandya.
Venus is called Bhrgu, Ushna, Bhargav Soonu, Achha, Kaan, Kavi, Daitya guru, Sit.(61)
Saturn is called Chhayaatmaj, Pangu, Yama, Arkputra, Kon, Asit, Sauri, Shani, Neel, Kroor, Kapilaaksha, Deergha, Tam, Asur, Agu, Sainhikeyaa. (62)

Rahu is also called Swarbhaanu Vidhuntud.
Ketu is called Shikhi, Dhvaj.
Maandi is called son of Saturn (Shane Suta) Gulik, Maandi, Yamaatmaj, Pranhar, Atipappi. (63)
Praanpad is called Praan. There are many other names of various planets. (64)

The Sun has a square body. Its colour is dark red, the lustre of his eyes is yellow, has the body humour of bile., of average length in the bodily stature, has prowess, is satvik in nature, has very little hair (66) is intimately linked to causing movements, possesses a speech which gives meaning in very few words, gives very little, his intellect is divinely oriented; Moon is of white body, of average size, well at speech, with round body, has the power of right thinking, is somewhat (67) weak in body, has pleasing speech, is satvik in temperament, possesses all the three humours i.e. bile, phlegm & wind. Mars has eyes red with anger, has body whitish red in colour, possesses bile i.e. has heated nature, has haughty temperament, is thin of body, is prone to sin, has prowess, is given to sexual pleasures. Mercury is of the colour of green grass, is highly learned, is ambitious, truthful in speech. (68) He is jocular, possesses all the three humours bile, phlegm & wind, gives status etc., with quickness, & is impotent. (69) Jupiter is of satvik temperament, is endowed with all the good qualities of character, has yellow eyes, has no hair on the head. Venus has beautiful eyes, is sexy in nature, gives comforts, strength, & beautiful complexion. (70) Venus has black coloured hair on his body is ambitious in nature, is endowed with all the good qualities. Saturn is cruel, with a thin long body, yellow eyes, & hard hair. (71) He has big sized teeth, is tamasic in nature (full of inertia) causes wind i.e. nervous troubles, is curt in speech, & is despicable. The results of the planets should be declared after due consideration of their strength whether it is the domain of natal astrology or of the horary astrology. (72)

Jupiter and Venus are brahmins, the Sun and Mars are kshatriyas or of the warrior class, Moon & Mercury belong to the trading community, Saturn belongs to shuddra, Rahu and Ketu represent the lower most strata of one's community. Mandi represents a foreign community other than the set of communities in which one is born. (73, 74)

Sun is red coloured, Moon is white, Mercury green, Jupiter yellow, Venus of variegated colour, Saturn is blue. The devata of Sun is Agni, (fire) that of Moon is Jala (water), of Mercury Vishnu (protection), of Jupiter Indra (wealth), of Venus Indrani (sex)- the wife of Indra, of Saturn is Brahma (long life). The directions represented by the planets are East by Sun, South East by Venus, South by Mars, South West by Rahu, West by Saturn, North West by Moon, North by Mercury and North East by Jupiter. The signs Aries, Leo & Sagittarius represent the East, Taurus, Virgo, & Capricorn represent the South, Gemini, Libra & Aquarius represent the West & Cancer, Scorpio & Pisces represent the North. (75)

Mars, Saturn, Sun & Moon that is near the Sun (i.e. within 72 degrees on either side of Sun) & Mercury associated with the malefics are treated as malefics. Other planets and unafflicted Mercury and full Moon are benefics. Saturn and Mercury are treated as enunch planets, Moon and Venus are treated as females. Sun, Mars & Jupiter are treated as male planets. The dominant influence of male etc planets gives male etc birth. Mars represents muscles, Jupiter fat, Venus semen, Mercury skin, Moon blood, Sun bones, Saturn nerves. Disease should be considered as in the tissue concerned by the affliction of these planets. Planets located in the 8th house cause death through their respective tissues etc. (76-78)

Sun (being satvik) is intimately linked to the Dev Sthaan i.e. the temple etc, Moon to watery resorts, Mars to fiery places, Mercury (being kumar i.e. boy) to play grounds, Jupiter (being the significator of wealth) to treasury etc, Venus (being sexy) to the bed room, Saturn to uneven places, Rahu to holes of serpents etc. (79)
If Saturn represents a cloth, it would be old; if Sun, it would be gross; if Jupiter, it would be neither old nor new; if Venus, it would be strong; if Moon, new; if Mercury, it would be wet, if Mars, it would be partially burnt, if Rahu, it would be old & of various colours like the cloth of a poor menicant; if Ketu, it would be with many holes. (81)

Sun represents Copper, Moon Gems, Mars Gold, Mercury represents ore of Pearls, Jupiter Silver, Venus Pearls, Saturn Iron, (82) Rahu represents Lead & Ketu represents Neelam. Amongst the clothes, yellow cloth is represented by Jupiter, Silken by Venus, variegated by Sun, white by Moon, Green by Mercury, dark red by Mars, blue by Saturn, old by Rahu, beautiful by Ketu. The strength of planets should be given due consideration in this context (85).

37 Venus represents the Vasant season (March and April) Mars & Sun represent the Summer season (May & June) Moon stands for the Rainy season (July & August) Mercury for the Sharad season (September & October) Jupiter for Hemant (November & December) & Saturn for the Shishir season (January & February). (86)

In horary astrology, in natal astrology or when the question of reconstructing a horoscope without the birth data is involved the data is ascertained from the nature of the planets who are the lords of the decantes involved. Among the tastes, the Sun represents the Pungent taste, Mars the bitter, Moon the saltish, Mercury the mixed one, Jupiter the sweet, Venus sour & Saturn astringent. In periods of time, the Sun represents a period of six months, Moon only a second, Mars a day, (89) Mercury a period of two months, Jupiter a month, Venus a fortnight & Saturn a year, Rahu represents a period of 8 months & Ketu only 3 months.

Rahu, Saturn, Moon and Mars are planets representing Dhatu i.e. metals. Sun and Venus represent planets, Jupiter and Mercury are jeevas i.e. Animals including man. The signs and the asterisms Ashvini, Bharni & Kritika are metals, plants & Animals respectively. Similar is the case in order for the rest of the asterisms i.e. Rohini, Mrigshar & Ardra are metals, plants & Animals & so on. (90)
The Sun and Mars have "upwards" sight. Venus and Mercury look slantingly. Moon and Jupiter look straight. Saturn and Rahu look downwards. (91)

Saturn fully aspects i.e. influences the house, sign or planet placed 3rd and 10th from it. Mars similarly aspects the house etc. placed 4th and 8th from it. Jupiter similarly throws its influence on the house etc 5th and 9th from it. All the planets aspect the 7th house etc from the place of their location. The planets aspect the 3rd & 10th place from their places with quarter aspect, the place etc 5th & 9th from them with half aspect & the house etc 4th & 8th from them with three quarters aspect. The house numbers should be counted by taking the aspecting planet as in first house. (92) Most of the astrological texts do not prescribe any aspects for Rahu and Ketu. They omit it at their own peril. Maharshi Parashar—the father of Indian astrology—has very clearly laid down that Rahu and Ketu have aspects mostly similar to Jupiter i.e. on the house etc 5th, 7th & 9th from them.
In this connection please see the following shloka (number 26 in chapter 51) of Brihat Parashar Hora Shastra Bombay edition of Shaka 1837.

i.e. Rahu has full aspect on the house etc located 5th, 7th, 9th and 12th from it. It has half the aspect (influence) on the houses 2nd and 10th from it. It aspects with a quarter strength the house etc 3rd and 6th from it and is blind towards the house it occupies.
Since the shadowy planets Rahu and Ketu easily take upon themselves the influence of other planets etc. we have deduced a corollary from the above rule that in throwing their own malefic influence on the house these shadowy planets may be aspecting, they will also throw on the aspected houses the malefic influence of the malefic planet or planets that may be influencing these nodes, by association or aspect. For example, if Ketu & Mars are located in the 6th house in any horoscope or if Ketu is located in the 6th house & Mars in the 3rd, 11th or 12th house, then Ketu in throwing its 5th, 7th & 9th aspect will convey to the 10th, 12th & the 2nd houses and will afflict the said houses with the malefic influence of Mars as well. This corollary has great impact on the “Kuja Dosha” for even though when for example Mars & Ketu are located together in the 6th house, Mars does not constitute technically “Kuja Dosha” in accordance with shloka relating to this dosha viz.

etc. But in actual effect it would shorten the life of the partner very much because the influence of both Mars & Ketu (killers) would be felt by the 2nd house which being the longevity (8th) house of the partner is bound to suffer through the influence of Mars & Ketu (who also acts like Mars).

The Sun considers Jupiter, Mars and Moon as its friends, It is neutral towards Mercury. It is inimical to Saturn and Venus. Moon considers the Sun and Mercury as its friends. It treats the rest i.e. Saturn, Venus, Jupiter and Mars as a neutral. Mars treats Sun, Moon & Jupiter as its friends. It is inimically disposed towards Mercury. It is neutral to Saturn and Venus. Mercury treats the Sun and Venus as its friends. It is neutral towards Jupiter, Mars and Saturn, but it is inimical to Moon (94) Jupiter treats Sun, Mars and Moon as friends, but Venus and Mercury as enemies. Jupiter is neutral to Saturn. Venus treats Saturn and Mercury as its friends, It is inimical towards the Sun and the Moon & is neutral towards Jupiter and Mars (95). Saturn treats Venus and Mercury as its friends, Jupiter as neutral. While it treats the Sun, Mars and Moon as its enemies. Rahu treats Venus, Jupiter and Saturn as its friends. So also is the case with Ketu. (96)

Planets located in the 2nd, 3rd or 4th house from another planet or in the 12th, 11th or 10th from it become temporary friends of the latter. In other places they become natural enemies. In case the two are both natural & temporary friends they become Adhimitra i.e. bosom friends. If both are inimical naturally & temporarily they become bitter enemies. If friends in one way and enemy in another they are neutral to each other. (97, 98)

Planets located in their sign of exaltation, in a friendly sign, in their own Navamsha sign, in the signs they own, in their own decante or in 1/12th part, or in their own 1/16th part are considered to possess “Positional” strength. (99) Jupiter and Mercury have full directional strength when located in the ascendant. Mars & Sun get this full strength when located in the 10th house, Saturn gets it when located in the 7th house, Moon and Venus get full directional strength when situated in the 4th house. Planets are in zero directional strength when located in the 7th house from that where they get full directional strength. In the intervening situations planets get proportional strength. (100) Sun etc. located in their own month hora, day or year are considered as strong in temporal strength. (101) i.e. Sun in the Bhadon month (August and September), Moon in its own hora division, Mars on Tuesday & Saturn in the year when it is in its own sign, Capricorn or Aquarius, are considered as strong. (101)

Saturn, Moon and Mars get strengthened in a night birth. The Sun, Jupiter and Venus get strengthened in a day birth. Mercury is strong both in day and night births. Benefic planets get strengthened in the bright fortnight of the Moon while the malefics get strengthened in the dark fortnight. (102) The planets aspected by benefics and unaspected by malefics are strong so far as the question of aspect is concerned. The Sun is very strong in the Uttarain (six months from the Sun's entry into Capricorn). Moon is strong when the Sun is in Dakshanayan (i.e. in six months from its entry into Cancer). (103) In natural strength Saturn, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, Moon and Sun are stronger in order one over the other i.e. Saturn is the least strong & Sun the most. (104) Planets Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus and Saturn are strong when in retrogression. A planet is victorious in war when it has in comparision more northern declination and has brilliant rays (i.e. are away from the Sun). (105)

The strength of the Ascendant (and its lord) consists mainly in their sixfold strength. In regard to the strength of the Ascendant the Author says that if the Ascendant is a human sign (see shloka 51 anti), the ascendant gets full strength. If the sign is watery or animal, the strength of the Ascendant is half. Incase there is insect sign in the Lagna the Lagna gets no strength on this account at all. Sixfold strength of the Ascendant is as under. (106, 107)

The maximum strength in the sixfold ways for the Sun is 6 and a half rupas, rupa being a unit of strength. That of Moon is 6 rupas, of Mars 5, of Mercury 7, of Jupiter 6, of Venus 5 and a half, (108) of Saturn 5. The actual strength is worked out proportionately. In positional strength it is two rupas 3 quarters, in directional strength it is 1 rupa & 3 quarters. (109) In Cheshta strength it is a rupa less by 1/6th of it, In temporal strength it is 2 rupas less by one eighth of a rupa. Sun, Mercury and Jupiter get half a rupa strength in the Ayan strength. In the sixfold strength Sun gets the maximum strength of six and a half units. Moon gets 6 units, Mars 5, Mercury 7, Jupiter 6, Venus five and a half, and Saturn 5. In the positional strength the maximum units are a quarter less three units. The maximum directional strength is three quarters of a unit. (109) The Cheshta (motional) strength is 5/6th of a unit. In temporal strength it is 2 units less 1/8th. In Ayan strength Sun, Mercury and Jupiter get half a unit. (110)

The directional strength is a unit less by 1/6th of it i.e. 50/60. The positional strength is a quarter more than 2 units. Temporal strength is one third less than 2 i.e. 1-40. The motional strength is half unit (iii) Ayan strength is 2/3rd of a unit. Moon, Jupiter & Venus get motional strenght as 2/3rd unit. In Kaal Bal & as one & one eighth unit. (1-7-5) (112) Saturn has half a unit as its directional and Ayan strength, Mars has two & a half units as its positional strength. Native with 2 or more than 2 of them are involved the period becomes particularly harmful. This is the reason why the time when both a sign & a Nakashtra are ending, such as the end of signs Cancer, Scorpio & Pisces are considered dangerous to life when occupied by Moon. (113)

A planet having a longitude up to the longitude of the house in which placed is called “Aarohi” (i.e. mounting). If it has greater longitude than that it is called “Chyut” (i.e. fallen). A planet that occupies a junction point is without results particularly in its dasa periods, even if it ocupies its sign of exaltation, a friendly sign & even if endowed with all the six types of strengths. The position of the Ascendant is (a) tringular to the “Pranpada” (b) is triangular to the sign occupied by “Maandi” (115) (c) is triangular to the Navamsha sign occupied by “Maandi” (d) is in the 7th to the Navamsha sign occupied by “Maandi” (e) is triangular to the sign occupied by the Moon or (f) in the sign 7th to the Navamsha sign occupied by Moon (116). The learned thus determine the Ascendant both in natal and horary astrology. Importance is given to the Ascendant or the sign occupied by Moon whichever is stronger. (117)

In case the Ascendant is sronger, the process of rectification of the Ascendant should be carried out from the Maandi. If Moon is stronger the process should be undertaken with Moon as the base. In case the Ascendant arrived at is of odd sign and odd Navamsha the birth is of a male, if these two belong to an even sign the birth is of a female. (118)

In the following sets of four planets the first is “Pachak” (literally digestor) Bodhak (lit: informative), Karka (significator or doer) & Bedhak (piercing). The sets are (1) Saturn, Mars, Jupiter & Venus, (2) Venus, Mars, Saturn & Sun, (3) Sun, Moon, Saturn & Mercury, (4) Moon, Jupiter, Venus & Mars, (5) Saturn, Mars, Moon & Sun, (6) Moon, Mercury, Sun & Saturn (7) Venus, Moon, Jupiter & Mars. (119-121)
The aforesaid Pachak, Bodhak etc. for different planets are as under:-

To the Sun its Pachak planet acts as its enemy. The rest are friendly to Sun. The planet 12th to Moon is her enemy. Bedhak of Mars acts as its enemy. Bedhak for Mercury is its enemy; for Jupiter the Pachak planet is enemy. For Venus the Bedhak planet is enemy. The Karka for Saturn is its enemy. The rest are its friends. (126)

The Pachak planet normally gives high career, high favour from Government, Education, pleasure in the company, The men in Power. In case the Pachak planet is also the friend of the planet having its dasa, it gives high class food, clothes, ornaments, ruling powers, wealth, lands & high comforts. (127-128)
A Bodhak planet, if it is also friendly to the planet to whom it is Bodhak, gives excellent results beyond expectations arising out of one's own hard work & otherwise, if not friendly. (129)

If the Karaka planet is friendly to the planet for whom it is Karaka, it gives some times better prospects and some times loss of fortune, some times disease to wife, son, relatives of wife, fear from thieves, fire, and conflict with others. (130) In case the Karak planet is enemy to the planet to whom it is Karaka, then it gives in its dasa extremely bad results in regard to theft, fire, trouble to relatives, suffering at the hands of the Government and loss of position of self. (131)
If the Bedhak planet is friendly to the planet to whon it is Bedhak, it brings about Foreign travel & loss of Wealth. If it is inimical, the results are opposite. (132)

At a place where the measure of the day time is 30 ghatis i.e. 12 hours, the Gulik occupies the degree denoted by the Ishta (interval between the Sun rise & the coming moment of birth) of 26 ghatis on Sunday, 22 ghatis on Monday 18 ghatis on Tuesday 14 ghatis on Wednesday 10 ghatis on Thursday, 6 ghatis on Friday & 2 ghatis on Saturday. When the duration of the day is more or less than 12 hours the Ishta should be ascertained by the rule of 3 i.e. if on Sunday for 30 ghatis duration it is 26 ghatis, how much is it for the duration of the day involved. Having ascertained the Gulik Ishta concerned for the day involved, the Ascendant on that Ishta worked out in the normal manner gives the Gulik point. (133, 134)

Multiply the measure of the day time by 26, 22, 18, 14, 10, 6 & 2 respectively for the days Sunday to Saturday. Divide the result by 30, the answer will be the Ishta at which Mandi is. (135) The author has opined that the product of the duration of the day period concerned and 26 etc. should be divided by 30. This is obviously based on the assumption that the duration of the day would be 30 ghatis which is not the case in most cases. Hence the appropriate step is to divide the product by the duration of the day in ghatis instead of by 30 in every case.

If the planet having its sub-period is located in 6th, 8th or 12th, it is inimical (to some extent) to the planet having the main ruling period. If located in the rest of the houses except 7th, it acts as a friend to the dasa lord. The sub-period lord in 7th to the main period lord gives adverse results. (136) The fact that a planet is placed 6th, 8th or 12th from the planet having its main ruling period makes the sub-period lord adverse by one point. If it is enemy also of the main period lord it would be adverse by two points. If it is enemy to the lord of the Ascendant, it would be adverse by 3 point. If it is located 6th, 8th or 12th from the lagna it would be adverse by 4 points. If it is placed 6th, 8th & 12th from the lord of the lagna it would be adverse by 5 points. Thus a planet that indicates good results in its sub-period by even 4 points by being in a friendly sign, by owning good houses, by being in association with a benefic & by being in its own sign may still give slightly bad results for such a planet is good only on 4 counts & bad on 5.

The planet having its sub-period, if with a malefic, acts in an inimical manner. If the Sub-period lord is a good planet in himself and is also good from the point of view of the house it occupies from the Main-dasa lord, it gives very good results. Thus it is necessary to give the results after due consideration of the position held by the Sub-period lord from the Main-period lord. (137)
I, Venkateshwar Sharma, have stated the chapter of definitions taken as the essence from the Astrological works, for the benefit of all. It should be applied in the manner stated. (138)

The Rishis and men of ripe wisdom have given various results arising out of the association of the various planets with the various houses. I am presenting the same for the pleasure of the learned readers. (1)

If a natural benefic planet is lord of any house and is located in that house or aspects it and the houses aspected or associated are not under the influence of malefic planets by association or aspect, the house concerned gets boosted in regard to the traits related to it. Similarly natural malefic planets, lords of houses similarly situated do not give nice results. Planets in general are strong when they are not in debilitation, eclipsed by Sun or in inimical signs. (2)
If there are natural malefic planets in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the Ascendant etc and the lords of these houses are natural benefics, these benefics do not give much good results. (3)

The Traits of a house suffer, if its lord is located in the 6th, 8th or the 12th house. Similarly the lord of the 6th, 8th or the 12th house harms the prospects of the house in which it is located. If, however, is well aspected it gives good results. (4) 49

A house that contains its lord, or from whom there are in 5th, 9th, 2nd, 4th, 7th or 10th benefic planets and is not influenced by malefic planets get strengthened. If reverse is the case the houses become destroyed. If the yoga is mixed there are mixed results. This rule is applicable to all houses including the Ascendant. (5)

A house gets its traits destroyed if its lord is located in the 8th house, also if it is eclipsed by the Sun, or is in its debilitation sign, or in an inimical sign or is neither associated with nor aspected by benefics. In cases where a house contains a planet but that planet is weak in the manner stated above, even then the traits of the house get lost. This rule is applicable to all houses including the Ascendant. (6)

Source of income should be declared from the planet occupying the 10th house from the Ascendant or from the Moon, whichever is stronger. If the planet occupying is the Sun, the source is father, if Moon it is mother, if Mars the enemy, if Mercury the source is the relations, if Jupiter it is from brothers (elder), if Venus it is from wife, if Saturn the source of income is from servants. The livelihood is also determined from the nature of the planet who is lord of the Navamsha sign occupied by the lord of the 10th house. (7)

If the said lord of the Navamsha is Sun, one earns from medicine, gold, water, conveyance trade, pearls, ruby, Ambassadorship, (8) tours, advisory capacity, oxides, law suits, through pleasure affording matters, preceptorship & under Governmental patronage. (9)

If the lord of the said Navamsha is Moon, one earns from products of water, agriculture, from earth products, law suits, through pleasure affording matters (cinema etc), through the patronage of the royal females, or from the sale of cloth. (10)

If the said Navamsha lord is Mars, one earns from metal work, military occupation, from the use of fire (as in boilers etc), from engaging himself in creating trouble, from acts of courage, or through theft. (11)

If the said Navamsha is onwed by Mercury, one earns through handicrafts, literature, from scriptural usage, from Astronomy & Astrology, from moral means, from the study of the Vedas, from doing Japa work for others, or by acting as a family priest. (12)

If the Navamsha in question belongs to Jupiter, the native earns his livelihood by teaching the worship of the gods and Brahmins, or from the recitation, teaching etc of Puranas, & Vedas or by preaching religion. (13)
If the said Navamsha lord is Venus, one earns from gold, gems, elephants, horses, or from the sale of gur etc or from the trade in milk and curd or from the support of women. (14)

If the lord of the said Navamsha is Saturn, one earns by despicable means, from handicrafts etc, from wood works, from butchery etc, from carrying burden, from works connected with water, or by creating rift amongst parties. (15)

All planets when located in their own sign, in the Navamsha of their own sign, in a friendly sign, or in the degree of their exaltation, or in the decante of their own sign, or in the cardinal houses (1st, 4th, 7th & 10th) or in their positive signs (see shloka 53 of chap I) or when strong by virtue of their temporal strength or when located in the Navamsha belonging to the sign occupied by them, give nice results in their Main and Sub-ruling periods. (16)

One dealing with natal or horary Astrology, should declare the traits and characteristics of a house as lost when the planet having its Main or Sub-ruling period is (a) the lord of the 8th house from the house under consideration (b) when the planet having its Main & Sub-period is kharesh i.e. lord of the 22nd decante (see shloka 16 chapter I) or (c) when the said planet is Saturn as the lord of the decante of the said house, or (d) is the lord of the sign occupied by Maandi or (e) is the lord of the Navamsha sign or the lord of the sign occupied by Maandi, or (f) is located in a bad house such as 6th, 8th or 12th or (g) it is Adhi Shatru i.e. bitter enemy of the lord of the house involved (see shloka 17 of chapter I) or (h) when that lord is in a sign having no good point in the Ashtak Varga system. (17 & 18).

The following planets when weak bring about death in their Main and Sub-ruling periods:— (a) the lord of the Navamsha sign 52 occupied by Saturn (b) the lord of the Navamsha sign occupied by Maandi, (c) Rahu (d) the lord of the Navamsha sign occupied by "Khar" (see previous shloka) the lord of the 8th house from the Ascendant, & the lords of the Navamsha signs occupied by all these. This happens when Saturn in transit crosses the bad signs such as the one in 8th house etc. (19)

In case the lord of the second house (the House of Wealth) is having its Main ruling period and there is the Sub ruling period of any of the planets—Saturn, Mars, Rahu and Sun—then the Sub-period will give loss of wealth. So also is the case, if the second house contains a malefic planet (20) in the dasa of a malefic planet, lord of the 2nd house & in that of the lord of the sign occupied by the said malefic lord of the 2nd house, there is loss of wealth, brought about through the punishment orders of the Government. There is also at that time relinquishment of position and opposition from the near and dear ones. (21) Shloka number 20 makes no mention of the influence of the malefic Sub-period lords on the Main-period lord. It is, therefore, clear that there is always the influence of the planet having its Sub-period on the planet having its Main period. This should be taken as a law and applied to all Sub-periods to get correct results.
(2) The words " तदीश " (Tad Isha) in the opening part of shloka number 21, go to show that the lord of the sign occupied by the lord of any house acts as the latter. This is on the basis of the theory of dispositorship.

When both the Main and the Sub ruling period are of a malefic planet, the time indicates the destruction, loss etc of the articles of food, finances, honour, sons and brothers. When these Main and Sub period lords are benefics there is no harm. (22) During the Main ruling period of a benefic, placed in the second house and the Sub ruling period of a benefic lord of the second house, one gets wealth. Then there is also pleasure from speech and the sons. (23) The rationale behind the results in both the cases lies in the principle that the Sub-period lord always influences the Main-period lord.

Even if the lord of the 3rd house denotes good, the native will suffer from fire, weapons or thieves if there is the Main ruling period of a malefic lord of the 3rd house conjoined to a malefic planet and the Sub-period too is of malefic planets. (24)

During the main ruling period of a malefic lord of the 3rd house there is trouble from fire, thieves and Government. There is also inertia of mind; but, if it is aspected by a benefic planet, there is no such trouble. (25)

During the Main ruling period of the lord of the 3rd house & the Sub-ruling period of malefic planets there is loss of brothers & also rift with them. (26) Again note the fact that the results in the shloka arise from the malefic influence exerted on the Main ruling period lord by the planet having its Sub-period and this is irrespective of the location of the two in the horoscope.

During the Main ruling period of the lord of the 4th house and the Sub-ruling period of malefics, there is relinquishment of residence & the loss of brothers. Similar results follow during ths 54 Sub-periods of planets that are in debilitation, or are eclipsed by the Sun. (27) The Sub-period of Sun, Saturn and Rahu or of their dispositors is particularly instrumental in bringing about change of residence as these are all factors of "Separation", influencing the house of residence. (4th)

During the Main period of the lord of the 5th house, and the Sub-ruling period of malefics, the native gets confusion of intellect and bad food. But, if the Sub-period lord is a benefic, it does not happen. (28) It is stated that the native would suffer from taking of bad food. This is obviously the result of the affliction of the 5th house which represents the belly. Just as the 4th house from the House of Gains (11th) is the place, where income is deposited, on the same analogy the 4th house from the 2nd house of Food is the food lying in the stomach, which gets bad as a result of the malefic influence of the malefic planets having their Sub-period.

During the Main ruling period of the lord of the 6th house and the Sub-period of malefic planets the native suffers from the orders of the king, from thieves or from chronically bad habits as also from diseases like seminal troubles, colic pains, consumption, or bile. (29) From a study of the shloka it would be seen that the bad results in regard to wealth and health have arisen as a result of the affliction of the 6th house. Thus it would be right to assume that the 6th house is primarily one of "health" & of disease only when afflicted.

55 During the Dasa of the malefic lord of the 7th house, there is opposition from wife, or even her death. There is also foreign travel, trouble in the semen and rectum as also the wrath of the Government. (30)

During the Main ruling period of the lord of the 8th house and the Sub-period of Rahu, Mars, or Saturn, there is the loss of Longevity, fame and wealth of self and the destruction of wife, relatives & brothers. (31)

During the Main ruling period of the lord of the 9th house and the Sub-ruling period of Saturn, Mars, Rahu or the Sun the native suffers in his career, gets opposition from his brothers, travels to a foreign land & has rift with his brothers. If the lord of the 9th is a benefic, these results are modified in the Sub-period of the benefic. (32)

During the Main ruling period of the lord of the 10th house and the Sub-period of malefics there is likelihood of getting imprisonment, sorrow, bad dreams, and great mental worry. During this period the native gets defame. (33)
During the Main ruling period of the lord of the 11th house and the Sub-period of malefics Sun, Mars, Rahu or Saturn there is loss of things, paucity of work & income & wrath from the Government.

During the Main ruling period of the lord of the 12th house and the Sub-period of Saturn, Sun or Mars there is mental grief, consumption, loss of honour and wealth. During the Sub-period of Rahu there is trouble from serpent. (35)

In case the Sub-period lord is a temporary friend of the planet having its Main period it gives half the bad results of what it would give when it is the enemy of the Main Dasa lord. During the period when the Main Dasa lord and the Sub-period lord are located 6th & 8th to each other there is relinquishment of office or even death. (36) The learned people clarify in detail the results of the Main and the Sub-periods of planets. We have of necessity, narrated their results in a language of brevity. (37)

When during its transit, the Sun comes to the 3rd sign from that of the 1st conception, or when it comes in transit to the 5th or 9th house from the Ascendant at the time of other conceptions, people are born. (38) People well versed in the science of astrology are of the opinion that the Ascendant at the time of birth is the same as sign that constitutes the Ascendant at conception. In cases where the Ascendant at the time of conception contains a benefic planet or is aspected by a benefic, the native born is long-lived, with power and affluence. (39)

If from the Nishek Lagna the 5th, 2nd and the 9th houses are aspected by benefic planets or by male planets and if there is the Navamsha of a male planet in the Ascendant at the time of Nishek, birth of a male results. If contrary is the yoga a female is born. (40)

When at the time of Nishek Lagna, there is, in that lagna, Mercury or Saturn aspected by malefics, the birth will be only of a piece of flesh. But not so if that Ascendant is aspected by benefics. (41)

The location of the lord of the Ascendant and of the 3rd house in the Ascendant or in the 3rd house gives rise to the birth of twins. (42) The situation together of the Self of the native represented by the lord of the Ascendant & of its coborn represented by the lord of the 3rd house is essentially what contitutes a twin birth. We consider that the yoga for twin birth becomes certain if Mars—the significator of brothers & Mercury — the factor of "Plurality" also take part in the yoga involving lagna. For example, if Mars is in Ascendant in the sign with Mercury, the yoga becomes certain, for all the factors are together in lagna. Here is the horoscope of a twin. It would be seen that Moon in lagna is the dispositor of Saturn, the lord of the lagna. Hence any influence on lagna would also be on Moon & Saturn. The influence of Mercury is there. Since Mercury is lord of the sign occupied by Mars the influence of Mercury on lagna & its lord (Moon as Saturn) means the influence of Mercury, lord of the 3rd house, and the significator of the 3rd house (Mars). An intimate link having been established 58

between the lagna & the lord & significator of the third house, together with factor of plurality by Mercury. The twin birth is clear.
If the lord of the lagna is in the 10th house and Rahu in the lagna, the child's feet come out of the womb first. If the lord of the 8th house and Rahu are in the lagna the child is enveloped in serpent like umbilical cord. (43) If Rahu & Gulik are together in kendra or if the lord of the 1st & 8th houses are together and the decante in the Ascendant belongs to a malefic planet, the child is enveloped in the serpent like cord in the womb. (44) The same result follows if there is serpentine or egg decante in the Ascendant and the decante is with its lord without good aspect. (45) If Mars or Saturn is in any of the lagnas Aries, Taurus, Leo, the child in the womb is enveloped in the limb denoted by the sign of the lagna. (46)

If malefic occupies the Ascendant and many malefics aspect the lagna or if Rahu or Ketu is there, or if the lagna contains too many malefic planets, the native is enveloped with the cord. (47)
If malefic surround the Ascendant and Rahu is there or if Mars and Sun are aspected in it or Saturn is there aspected by Mars, the part indicated by the Navamsha is enveloped with the cord. (48)

If the lords of the first and the 4th houses are located in each others sign & if either the lord of the 1st or of the 4th is situated with 59 Rahu or Ketu, the yoga indicates birth of an animal. (49)

In case there is a malefic planet or a malefic sign in the 11th house, the boy even if he be the first born is with a sanskara such as is performed during pregnancy. If the lagna is Leo the delivery room has two doors. If Virgo is the lagna the birth takes place in a third class house. (59) The direction of the door is (i) in the direction of the lord of the Navamsha in the lagna (ii) in that of the lord of the 5th house (iii) in that of the strongest planet (iv) in the direction of the planet in the kendra (v) in that of the lord of the decante in the lagna. (60)

When in a nativity the malefic planets are strong & occupy their own sign and the benefics are located in a sign other than their own & where the Ascendant contains an animal sign the wise authors take it as a yoga for animal birth. (51)

If in the Ascendant there is the decante of a bird (the 2nd decante of Gemini, 1st of Leo, 2nd of Libra and first of Aquarius are bird decantes) and the Ascendant is aspected by a strong planet & when the sign & the Navamsha in the Ascendant is of a movable sign, or of Mercury, the birth then is of a bird. (52)

If the yoga mentioned in the previous shloka is aspected by Venus, the birth is of a cow. If it is associated with or aspected by Saturn, the birth is of a buffalow. If by Rahu or Ketu, the birth is of a Ram. Similarly other animals are born when their respective signs are in the Ascendant. (53)

If the lord of the 6th house is located in the Ascendant in the sign of Mercury and the lord of the Ascendant occupies the sign of Mercury the man along with his wife is impotent. In the said yoga, if Saturn and Mars take part then the male himself only will be impotent. (54) Saturn & Mercury are impotent planets. Here is the horoscope of an impotent person. Rahu, who always acts like Saturn—the impotent, is fully aspecting the 7th house and its lord. Mercury, another impotent planet, is also influencing the 7th house and its lord. Sun is with the 7th house and its lord as lord of the 12th house. Saturn too aspects the 7th house and its lord. Venus the semen is hemmed in between Saturn and Mercury, dispositor of Rahu etc. In view of heavy impotency influence on all factors of sex impotency resulted.

The following are the 6 yogas that give birth to impotent persons.
(a). When Sun and Moon aspect each other.
(b). When Saturn and Mercury occupy dual signs.
(c). When Saturn occupying an odd sign aspects the Sun or when Saturn is in dual sign & aspects the Sun.
(d). When Moon is located in odd sign in the Ascendant and is aspected by Mars located in a dual sign.
(e). When Moon & Mercury are occupying an even and odd sign respectively & when the Moon & the Ascendant are aspected by Mars.
(f). When the lord of the lagna is with Mercury. (55-57)

If the lords of the 10th & 9th houses are located in one of the bad houses, 6th, 8th or 12th and the lord of the Ascendant is strong, the boy even if born in a high family is without the ceremonies such as 'seemant' (a sanskara i.e. ceremony performed during the pregnancy of a woman). (58)

The ladies attending at the time of delivery should be determined from the planets located in the 2nd, 12th and the 10th houses. If in one of these houses there is Saturn the Woman belongs to the shudra class. If it is the Sun, she belongs to the kshatriya (warrior) class. (61)
If there is Rahu or Ketu, the attending woman belongs to a low class. Other planets there denote the attending woman as belonging to the class of the planet concerned.
The women attending should also be determined from the planets in the 2nd, 12th & the 4th house. (62)

The caste etc should be determined from the planets in association with the lords of the houses (mentioned in the previous shloka). (63)
As against the opinion of some who consider that it should be considered from the planets in these hosues. Jupiter, Mercury and Venus in these houses denote the women attending delivery as belonging to the Brahmin class. (64) In case these planets are occupying the Navamsha of a malefic planet the women will be widows. If Rahu or Ketu is located in a bad Navamsha there the woman would still be of the high class but widow.
In case of Saturn there the woman would be of black colour & a hunch back. (65) The number of the attending women should be determined from the number of planets involved. The number is many if many planets are located in one sign. (66)

If the Ascendant is a movable sign, the lamp will be moving by being taken from place to place. If lagna is fixed the lamp is stable. If it is a common sign the lamp would be in the hand. The number of lamps at birth should be declared by the number of planets in the lagna. (67)
The condition of oil should be told from the Moon while the wick of the lamp should be told by the condition of the lagna. Thus opine some. (68)

Good bodily health should be predicted when the lord of the Ascendant is situated in his sign of exaltation, or in the Navamsha of a friend, or in the Navamsha sign belonging to himself or when associated with or aspected by benefic planet (69). When the lord of the Ascendant is strong in a cardinal or trinal house, and is not under the aspect of any malefic planet then also good bodily health should be predicted.

If the Sun is located in the “Dev Lok” division (see shlokas 25 chapter 1) & the lord of the Ascendant is strong, the lord of the 9th house is in its sign of exaltation, the native becomes famous and fortunate.

If the lord of the lagna is (a) very strong (b) is in the varga of benefic planets (c) is exalted (d) is with a friendly planet (e) is in the Navamsha sign belonging to itself (f) is associated with a benefic, (g) is with the lord of a kendra the native has best of affluence, fame, wealth, grains & prosperity. (72)

If the lord of the lagna is located with a malefic planet, it harms the health etc. The same is the result if it is in the 8th house. If well aspected it gives good health etc. (73) In case the lord of the lagna is located with the lord of any of houses 6th, 8th or 12th or if the lord of any one of these bad houses is in lagna one suffers bodily. If, however, the lord of the lagna is weak but located in a kendra or trine one does not so suffer. (74) The lord of the sign occupied by the lord of the lagna is located in any of the bad houses 6th, 8th or 12th gives a weak body. Whatever be the house 1st, 2nd, 3rd etc. if the lord of the sign occupied by the lord of any house is badly placed the house suffers in its traits. (75) It would be seen from shloka number 75 that the dispositors of the lords of the various houses act for the traits of the houses concerned. This is a very important rule and should never be lost sight of.

If there is more than one malefic planet in the Ascendant and the Gulik is in a trinal house or if Rahu & Gulik are in the Ascendant, if the lord of lagna is with a malefic planet and Rahu is in the lagna then one is prone to be cheated or to suffer at the hands of thieves & the officials of government. (76)
If there is also the association of Saturn there is certainty of the said cheating etc.
If Rahu is in the Ascendant with Mars the Acharyas take it as a yoga for the native to have enlarged scrotum. (77)
If the lord of the Ascendant Mandi and Rahu are located in the 8th house or if Rahu is in the Ascendant, Gulik in a trinal house, and Mars is with Gulik the same trouble should be predicted. (78)

If the lord of the Navamsha sign occupied by the lord of the lagna is located with Rahu, Mars, Mandi etc and if the lord of the Navamsha occupied by the lord of the 8th house is with Rahu, the result is the same viz the enlargement of the scrotum. (79)

If Mars is the lord of lagna and is situated in the lagna and malefics influence it either by association or by aspect, the native gets head injury through stone or the sword. (80) If Saturn is similarly situated i.e. if Saturn is in the lagna under the influence, by association or aspect of malefic planets, the injury comes through nervous trouble, fire, weapons or a fall. The head of a native is big if the sign in the lagna is of 2 hours duration, not when it is half of it. (81) The idea is that the signs whose rising time is 2 hours or more (maximum) when in the first house would make the first house i.e. the head big in size.

If the rising time of the Sign in lagna is one hour, the head of the native is small. If a dry (other than watery) planet is in lagna & the lagna too belongs to a dry planet the body is weak and slim. (82) Similar is the result if the lord of the lagna is associated with a dry planet or is located in the sign of dry planets. In case there is the sign of a dry planet in the lagna and the lagna contains many malefic planets the result regarding the body being slim follows. (84)

If there is a watery sign in the Ascendant associated with benefic planets, the native will have a fat body. If the lord of the Ascendant is a watery planet & is strong & is associated with benefic planets then also the body is bulky. (85) In case the lord of the Ascendant is located in a watery sign, is associated with a benefic planet and aspected by a watery planet or if the sign in the Ascendant belongs to a benefic planet and the lord of the Navamsha occupied by the lord of the Ascendant is located in a watery sign the native has a bulky body. (86)

If the Ascendant sign belongs to a benefic planet and it is aspec-ted by any malefic planet, the native has a fat body. If Jupiter is in the Ascendant or it aspects the Ascendant, or if the watery sign in the lagna is aspected by Jupiter placed in a watery sign; (87) if there is a benefic in the Ascendant, which is also under the aspect of a benefic planet, even then the body is fatty.
If Saturn is in the Ascendant and is with Rahu, the trouble is from a Pischaach i.e. a bad dead soul. (88)

If the Sun located in the Ascendant is aspected by Mars, the native suffers from breathing trouble, consumption, spleen trouble.
If Mars in the Ascendant is aspected by Sun and Saturn, the native is prone to suffer from hurt by sword etc. (89)

If Ketu is in the Ascendant and is aspected by many malefic planets then surely the native suffers from the Pishaachaas and thieves. If the sign in the Ascendant is a movable one or if the lord of the Ascendant is located in a movable sign, the native is mostly on the move. (90)

In case the Ascendant contains a movable sign or if the Navamsha in the Ascendant belongs to a movable sign the man is on the move mostly in life. If the Ascendant belongs to a movable sign, its lord is a planet of fast movement and is aspected by a fast moving planet, the native moves in foreign lands. (91)

If the lagna is a fixed sign and is associated with planets of slow motion (eg Jupiter) the native remains in his own country in a wealthy and lucky condition. In case the lagna is under the influence of both movable and slow planets the native gets luck and fame through bad means by moving to different territories. (92) If the lord of the lagna is strong & located in its sign of exaltation the native possesses a sobre & influential gait. If the lord of the lagna is weak the native is a fool; but not so, if associated with or aspected by benefic planets. (93)

If the sign in the lagna belongs to a benefic planet and the lagna is also aspected by a benefic the native gets comforts of life from early child hood. This is not so, if the lagna is associated with a malefic. In case the Ascendant contains many malefic planets, one goes through troubles throughout life. (94) If the lord of the Ascendant is vargottam or is in Navamsha of its exaltation sign, in a friendly decante or associated with benefic or is under the aspect of a benefic, one leads a comfortable life till death. (95) A reading of the above shlokas indicates that the Ascendant not only relates to conditions at birth, it covers also life as a whole. That is why the excellence of lagna & its lord indicates comfortable conditions throughout life.

If natural benefics occupy the 1st, 11th and the 12th houses, the lord of the Ascendant is located in kendra in strength and Jupiter is in "Simhasan" amsha (see shloka 25 etc chapter 1) the native goes through comforts in the early and middle portion of his life. (96)

If the 1st, 2nd and 3rd houses are associated with and aspected by natural benefic planets, the lord of the Ascendant is a benefic planet and Jupiter is in "Paraavaataamsha" (see shloka 25 etc chapter 1) one gets comforts in the early and middle life. (97)

If Jupiter is located in kendra, if the lord of the lagna is strong and occupies "Paravataamsha" (see shloka 25 etc chapter 1) the native is happy with wife, son, friends and wealth. (98) If Venus is in "Devlokamsha" (see shloka 25 etc chapter 1), the lord of the lagna is in. "Gopuramsha" & the lagna is aspected by benefic planets, the native is happy in the middle and old age. (99) In case there is a benefic planet in the lagna, there are malefic planets in the 2nd house & kendras and the lord of the lagna is in "Uttamamsha" (see shloka 25 etc chapter 1) the native is happy except in the early part of his life. (100)

In case the Ascendant is occupied by a natural malefic planet, the second and the 9th house by a benefic and the lord of the Ascendant is located in the "Devlok" Amsha (see shloka 25 etc chapter 1) the native is comfortable in his early life. If opposite is the case i.e. the Ascendant is occupied by a malefic planet, the 2nd and the 9th house contain a malefic & the lord of the Ascendant is weak in varga strength 'one gets suffering in early life.

In case the lord of the Ascendant is situated in the 10th house and the Sun is located in the Ascendant with natural benefics and the lord of the Ascendant is in its sign of exaltation, the native gets good name and fame in life. It is clear from the shloka that the good situation of the 1st & 10th houses along with the Sun leads to fame. 1st house, 10th house and Sun are thus the three factors for fame.

If a malefic is located in the Ascendant, the lord of the Navamsha in the Ascendant is in kendra (cardinal house) with Rahu, a malefic planet is situated in the 10th house and there is a planet in its debilitation sign aspected by the Sun, the native gets much defame in life. (103)

In case the lord of the Ascendant is having aarohi strength i.e. is near its sign of exaltation & so also is the case with the lord of the 9th house, and each is situated with a natural benefic planet, the native gets much fame in life. (104)
If Venus is in the lagna, the native is happy in the first half of his life. In case there are malefic planets in the 4th and the 5th house, he gets troubles in the latter half of life. (105)

If the lord of the Ascendant is located with a benefic planet in his exaltation Navamsha, in the kendra or a trine, under the aspect of benefic planet, is with the lord of the 10th house, or is in his own sign, the native gets high luck, fame, wealth, grains and long life. (106)

If the lord of the lagna is very strong, and is without the aspect of any malefic planet on it and is on the other hand in any of the car-dinal houses under the aspect of benefic planets, the yoga is anti short life. Gives long life, virtues and wealth. (107)

When a native has no malefic planet in the cardinal houses (1st, 4th, 7th & 10th) or in trines (5th & 9th) or in the 8th house, and the . 70 lord of the Ascendant and Jupiter are in the cardinal houses, the native lives for a hundred year free from disease. (108)

If the lord of the 8th house is stronger than the lord of the Ascendant and malefic planets occupy the cardinal houses or the 8th and the 12th house, the native gets short or medium life. It is only after facing dangers with courage that he may get long life. (109)

If Mercury, Venus and Saturn are located in the 9th house in the same Navamsha or these are located in the Ascendant in the same Navamsha & if Moon is in the 6th or the 8th house the native lives for 2 thousand years. (110) A weak Moon in the 6th or 8th house is not conducive to long life. Hence it is implied that Moon should be quite strong by being farthest away from the Sun.

If all the planets are located in kendra or trine or the 2nd house in the Navamsha sign belonging to Jupiter, the native takes to sanyas from childhood & lives till the end of a yuga & is the author of many books. (111) If the Sun, Mars and Jupiter are in the Navamsha of Saturn, & are located in the 9th or 10th house in strong condition and the Moon is located in the last Navamsha of the lagna, the native is wealthy and lives till the end of the yuga. (112) A person who has the lord of the 9th house located in the 9th house & is aspected by Moon located in the Navamsha of Mars, the native born in Such a Yoga, is a great muni (thinker & philosopher) who writes on the teachings of shastras & lives long till the end of the yuga. (113)

If either the lord of the Ascendant or the lord of the Navamsha occupied by the lord of the Ascendant is located in the 2nd house, the native gets comforts of life (through profession etc) after the age of 20 years. (114)

If the lord of the Navamsha sign occupied by the lord of the Ascendant is located, in a cardinal or trinal house or in exaltation, or if the lord of the 11th house is similarly situated, the native gets comforts of life after the age of 30 years. (115)

In case the lord of the Ascendant is located in a benefic sign and is aspected by a benefic planet or is located in "Gopur" division (see shloka 25 etc chapter 1) he starts getting wealth from the age of 16 years. (116)
Thus Sh. Venkat Sharma describes the strength and weakness of planets and their aspects in the lagna. (117)

The following should be studied from the 2nd house :- Those who are dependent on the native, face, mouth, speech, the right eye, accumulated wealth, education, eating, servants & friends. (1) It is a point for note that the author has opined that education should be studied and determined from the 2nd house. We are also of the same opinion and do not consider it advisable to examine education from 4th or 5th house, as done by some other authors. The 4th house relates to desires & as such can give knowledge of our desired object which may not necessarily be connected with academic education. The 5th house relates to intelligence & fore sight rather than to education as such.

If the lord of the first house along with that of the 2nd house is located in any of the bad houses 6th, 8th or 12th, the man gets his bones broken. If the lord of the 2nd house along with Venus and Moon is located in the Ascendant the man becomes "Night blind". If, however, it is with a benefic or is in its sign of exaltation the night blindness does not take place. (2)

If the lord of the 3rd house and its significator i.e. Mars are located in Navamsha of their sign of debilitation & are in the company of malefics. and are in a malefic Shashti amsha (1/60th division), then the brothers are born but are short lived. (3)

If the Sun and Moon are in Leo Ascendant & are aspected by Mars and Saturn, loss of eye should be predicted. In case the yoga is one where the aspected planets, Sun and Moon, and the aspecting planets (Mars & Saturn) are both associated with natural benefic planet, the blindness does not take place. The native has only unrestful eyes. (4)

If there is a malefic planet in the 2nd house & the lord of the 2nd house is under the aspect of benefic planet, the native has his eyes as if closed. If the lord of the lagna is with many malefic planets & aspected by Saturn, the native has disease in his eyes. (5)

If benefic planet occupies the 2nd house, or if the lord of the 2nd house is associated with benefics & if the significator of the eye i.e. the Sun is with the lord of the lagna or aspected by it the native has very good eye sight. (6)

In case the lord of the 2nd house is situated with Saturn and Mars or is with Gulik, there will be disease in the eye. Similarly, if there are many malefic planets aspected by Saturn, the eyes get diseased. (7)

If the lord of the Navamsha sign occupied by the lord of the 2nd house is located with a malefic or is in the sign of a malefic planet there is disease in the eye. So also will be the case, if Sun is the lord of the 2nd house and is in association with and aspected by malefics. Similarly, if Sun is in the company of Gulik & is aspected by Mars. (8)
If the 3rd house is aspected by malefic planets, the lord of the 3rd is in the 3rd house in malefic Shashti amsha (1/60th division) there is the destruction of brothers. (9)

The disease etc to the eyes of the brothers, son, enemy, wife, friend etc should also be determined in the same manner. If the lord of the 2nd house is located with the Sun and Mars or is aspected by them, the native has redness in the corners of his eyes. (10) The right eye of the younger brother is denoted by the house 2nd to 3rd i.e. the 4th house. If the 4th house & its lord along with the Sun suffer at the hands of Saturn & Mars, the younger brother will have serious trouble in his right eye. Similarly, the 6th house, its lord & Sun highly afflicted, give serious trouble in the right eye of the son & so on.

The author opines that if the lord of any house and its significator are natural benefics but are associated with malefics and are without the aspect of benefics but are under the aspect of malefics the eyes of the relation represented by that house such as father etc suffer. (11)

If the lord of the 2nd house is a natural benefic planet, situated in kendra or in its sign of exaltation or in a friendly sign or in a sign of a benefic, the native protects or rears up his family and many others & has a very nice speech. (12) If the lord of the lagna is strong and in its sign of exaltation and if there is a benefic in his exaltation sign in the 2nd house, aspected by a benefic, then also the native supports many persons.
