(13) If Jupiter occupies its own sign in the 2nd house or if Venus or Mercury are similarly situated in their own sign in the 2nd house, or if these planets are in their sign of exaltation or friendly sign in the 4th house, the native is helpful to & protector of others. (14)

If the lord of the 2nd house is a natural malefic & happens to be associated with or aspected by malefics & is himself in his sign of exaltation and if the lord of the Ascendant is weak & associated with malefics, the native has no body to help him in his living. (15) In case there are many natural malefics in the 2nd house and the lord of the 2nd house is weak, and aspected by malefics and the lord of the lagna is placed in any of the bad houses (6th, 8th or 12th) with malefics, the native has no comfort in life. (16)

In case the lord of the 2nd house is located in the 3rd house & is aspected there by male planets (Sun, Mars & Jupiter) & is in occupation of a friendly sign or is in exaltation,. the native is the ruler of all men. (17)

If the lord of the 2nd house is located in Gopuramsha (see shloka 25, Ch. 1) and the lord of the Navamsha occupied by the lord of the 2nd house is a natural benefic planet or if it is in "Simhasanamsha", the native protects (through his wealth) 50 people. (18)

If the lord of the 2nd house is located in its sign of exaltation, or in its Mool trikon (positive) sign, in the 11th house, the lord of the lagna is strong, and the lord of the sign occupied by the lord of the 2nd house is located in kendra, the native rules as a king. (19)

If the 2nd house contains a malefic planet, and the lord of the 2nd is associated with and aspected by malefic planets, the native earns his livelihood with much difficulty. (20)

In case the lord of the 2nd house is associated with natural benefics & the Moon in the 2nd house is in the Paravataamsha, the native supports 20 people in their livelihood. (21)

If the lord of the 2nd house is located in his sign of exaltation or in friendly sign, or in his own sign, or occupies the "Simhaasan" division or the "Paravataamsha" division & is aspected by Jupiter, the native blessed with merit rules over 300 people. (22)

If the lord of the 2nd house is in its highest degree of exaltation and is well aspected by Jupiter & the 2nd house too is similarly well situated, the native rules by his prowess over a thousand people. (23) A reading of the above shloka shows that the excellence of the 2nd house and its lord indicates support of others by the native. It may be due to the fact that good use of accumulated wealth, to which the 2nd house relates lies in the help of others. It is also significant to note that the 2nd house of any horoscope is the 11th house—the house of gains of the masses (4th house) & hence the people in general gain much through the excellence of their house of gains.

If the lord of the Ascendant is a friend of the lord of the 3rd house, the native is friendly to his brother. If it is enemy there is enmity. This rule of friendship can be applied to father and other relatives as well. (24)

If the lord of the 3rd house and Mars are located in the Navamsha of an odd sign and are aspected by Jupiter, Sun, or Mars located in the 3rd house, in this condition the native gets male coborns. (25)

When the lord of the 2nd house is in kendra (cardinal house) located in its exaltation sign, or in a friendly sign or in its own varga (see shloka 25 etc of chapter 1) or the lord of the 2nd house is in "Gopur" amsha (see shloka 25 etc of chapter 1) one has the most smiling face. (26)

When the 2nd house contains malefic planets and the lord of that house too is located with malefic planets or is in its sign of debilitation & aspected by malefics the native has a very bad look-ing face. (27) If the lord of the 2nd house is with Gulik and influenced by many malefic planets, the native is full of anger & sinful & falls in the hands of his enemies. (28)

Or the number is denoted by the sign and Navamsha of the planet associated with the lord of the 3rd house and Mars. The stronger of these located in better amsha gives the number, or the number should be determined from the Rashmis (see note below) of these two planets. The number lost should be determined by the number of malefic influences & the location in bad amshas such as Kal. (29)

When there are different types of yogas the result should be declared from the stronger of two i.e. Mars & the lord of the 3rd house. (30) Rashmi is the proportional strength of a planet due to its distance from the point where it is in highest debilitation. Suppose we desire to ascertain the number of Rashmis possessed by the Sun when its longitude is 11-14-10. Taking out 6-10 from it, the remainder 5-4-10 is the distance of Sun from its highest degree of debilitation. Multiplying 5-4-10 by 7 we get 35-29-10 which divided by 6 gives us 5-29-52 i.e. about 6 Rashmis (for further details see shloka 1 of chapter IV of "Maan Sagari Paddhiti").

If the lord of the 3rd is exalted, strong, in Kendra or trine, aspected by benefics or in own Mool Trikon, own or friendly sign and in "Vaisheshishik" Amsha, the native is patient, brave and learned. (31)

If the lord of the 2nd house is located in kendra in the Paravatamsha (see shloka 25 etc of chapter 1) & in its highest degree of exaltation & if Jupiter or Venus is in "Simhasanamsha" (see shloka 25 etc of chapter 1) associated with Mercury in its own sign and Navamsha, the native is a great speaker. (31) If the lord of the Navamsha occupied by the lord of the 2nd house is a natural benefic planet and is in exaltation with a benefic planet or is in Gopuramsha, the native is efficient & great speaker. (32)

If the lord of the 2nd house is strong and located with a benefic planet or is in its own sign and Navamsha, the native is a good speaker. If the lord of the 2nd house is with Jupiter and located in "Paravatamsha" (see shloka 25 etc of chapter 1) or is in "Airavatamsha" & is with Mercury or Venus & if it is in its sign of exaltation or in a friendly sign the man speaks too much. (33)

If the lord of the 2nd house is located with a malefic planet in the 10th house, in its sign of debilitation and with the Sun & with Mandi & the 2nd house has Sun in it aspected by malefics, the native is unable to speak in any assembly. (34)

If Mercury is located in a cardinal house, the lord of the 2nd house is strong & Venus is located in the 2nd or 3rd house with a benefic, or if Venus is in exaltation in the 2nd house, the native becomes foremost amongst the Astrologers. (35)

If Mars is in the 2nd house along with the Moon aspected by Mercury or with Mercury in kendra, the native understands mathematics. (36)
If Mercury is the lord of the 2nd house & is in its sign of exaltation, Jupiter is in the Ascendant, and Saturn in the 8th house, the yoga makes the native a mathematician. (37)
If Jupiter is in kendra or in trine, & Venus is in its sign of exaltation or if the lord of the 2nd house & Mercury are in their signs of exaltation, the native becomes a mathematician. (38)
If the lord of the 2nd house is Sun or Mars and is aspected by Jupiter and Venus, & Mercury is in "Paravatamsha" (see shloka 25 etc of chapter 1) the native knows the rationale of Astrology. (39) The role of Mercury in making one an Astrologer lies in the fact that a strong Mercury would give mathematical ability. The capacity to understand & know the future is given by the excellence of the 5th house & its lord, for the 5th house relates to "future" as distinct from the 9th house which relates to the past (having crossed the horizon before birth). But to earn from Astrology it would be necessary that there should be an intimate link between the lagna representing the self of the native & the 5th house representing the future. A link of Jupiter—the planet that can foresee the future with the lagna & its lord would give intuitive powers to the native. In addition, if the lagna and its lord are in intimate relation with the 4th & the 12th houses and their lords, this would be an indication that the native earns from the 4th & the 9th houses i.e. from the personal affairs of the public (4th house) & their prospects in life (9th from 4th is the 12th house). This is after all what makes a good Astrologer.

When the lord of the 2nd house is either Jupiter or Venus & is aspected by Sun & Mars & is located in the Mool trikon (positive) sign or in the sign of exaltation, the native is foremost among the knowers of the science of logic. (40) If Jupiter as the lord of the 2nd house is in high strength and is under the aspect of Sun and Venus, the native becomes a grammarian. (41)
If the lord of the 3rd house is with Saturn, he is fool, if with Rahu, he is brave only outwardly. If it is with Ketu or Mandi the results are the same as shown for the association of Rahu. (42)

If Jupiter is in the Ascendant, with the lord of the 3rd house, there comes danger from animals. If the lord of the 3rd house is in a watery sign in the lagna the danger comes from cows. There is trouble from water also. (43)

If the lord of the 3rd house is with Rahu in lagna & also with the lord of the sign occupied by Rahu, the native may be bitten by a serpent. If the lord of the 3rd house is with Mercury, there is disease in the throat. (44)

If there is a planet in the 3rd house in its sign of debilitation, or it is in an inimical sign in that house, and eclipsed, & aspected by malefics, there is danger from poison either by its use or by its consumption. If the above yogas are not there, there is no danger from poison. (45)

If the lord of the Navamsha sign occupied by the lord of the 2nd house is in the cardinal or trinal house with a malefic planet the native goes back on his word. So also is the case when Mars is similarly situated as the lord of the Navamsha occupied by the lord of the 2nd house. (46) 81

The native suffers from throat troubles if there is a malefic planet particularly Mandi in the 3rd house. If Mars is there in Yama Amsha (see shloka 49 of chapter 1) the native suffers from ear disease. (47)

If Saturn located in the 3rd house is with Mandi & has no benefic influence over it the native has nervous trouble in the ear The trouble is also there in the following case. Find out the sign in which the lord of the third house is located. See then if the sign and the Navamsha sign in which the lord of that sign is located are in kendra. (48)

If the lord of the Ascendant is in the 2nd house or is located in the Ascendant itself but is in its sign of exaltation and in association with a benefic planet & the lord of the lagna is in "Paravatarnsha" (see shlokas 25 etc of chapter 1) & Venus is in the 12th house, the native knows, Vedas & Vedanta. (49)

If the lord of the Navamsha sign occupied inturn by the lord of the Navamsha occupied by the lord of the Ascendant is strong, in the division called "Vaisheshik" & is in association with or under the aspect of benefic planets, the native gets much income depending on the number of good yogas. (50)

(1) The author has not said much on the question of enemies to which the house number 6 is very intimately connected. In this connection it may be stated that exclusive influence of benefic planets on the 6th house and its lord indicates the absence of enemies. The affliction by malefics of the 6th house and its lord leads to the creation of enemies. while the question who will win whether the native or his enemies has to be decided from the fact as to who is more strong. If the lagna & its lord are stronger than the 6th house and its lord the native wins & if otherwise is the case, the enemies win. The aspect of planets whether benefics or malefics has to be given more weight than the association of planets. The horoscope of Shri J.L. Nehru is an illustration in this context. His horoscope is as under. The fact that Jupiter in dignity is in the house of enemies with Ketu aspected by Mars means he has mighty enemies. Their nature is denoted by the nature of the influence falling on the 6th house. The 6th house is aspected by Mars, lord of the 10th house (government) & of the sign occupied by the Sun (again government). Hence his lifelong struggle against the British Empire. But the enemy was ultimately defeated due to the fact that the lagna & its lord Moon are stronger than the 6th house and its lord Jupiter. Moon has much strength by virtue not only of being in its own sign in kendra, but also due to being away from the Sun while Jupiter though in its own sign is a smaller planet in natural strength than Moon. Then Moon has the malefic side influence on Saturn and Rahu whereas Jupiter has aspect (as distinct from association) of Mars & Rahu. Hence Nehru won against the British Empire.

Hence it is considered that by the term "malefic planet" only planets such as Saturn & Rahu should be taken.

141 If the lord of the 5th house is occupying its sign of debilitation, or is eclipsed by the Sun, or is located in an inimical sign or is aspected by a malefic planet & is located in a malefic Shashti Amsha (1/60th division), the native has very little of intelligence. (45)

If Saturn is located in the 5th house, the lord of the lagna is aspected by Saturn & the lord of the 5th house is in association with malefic (other than Mars. See shloka 44), the native has very little of intelligence. (46)

If there is no beneflc planet in the 5th house, also this house contains Saturn, Mandi & Rahu, & the lord of the 5th house is aspected by malefic, the native often loses memory. (47) Each of the planets—Saturn, mandi and Rahu—are known for not only their scantiness but also for their power of removal. Hence memory a trait of 5th house is both made scanty & removed under the yoga stated.

If the lord of the 6th house is aspected by a benefic, or is associated with a benefic and is located in the sign of a benefic planet, this constitutes a yoga for friendship with the enemy. (48) If the 6th house and its lord are entirely under benefic influence, the yoga indicates the absence of enemies. In case there is some 155 malefic influences but by far the most benefic ones the yoga indicates enemy & the friendship.

If a benefic planet is located in the 5th house, and is aspected by Jupiter and Venus & the lord of the 5th house is also similarly aspected the native imparts his learning & intellect to others. (49)

If the lord of the 1st house is located in the 8th house & is aspected by the lord of the 6th house or when both of them are located in the 1st house, the yoga indicates trouble to maternal brothers and sisters. (50)
If Jupiter and Venus are located in the first house together with the lord of the 6th house & are aspected by Saturn, Mars & Rahu the yoga indicates trouble to people of the native's community. (51)

If the lord of the first house is with benefics & there is in the 6th house Moon or other benefic planet & if a benefic occupies kendra or the trine, the native lives in cordiality with his community. (52)
If the lord of the 6th house is Jupiter who is with benefics and aspected by benefics & located in Mridu amsha etc, the native has many members of his community (sons & daughters of his mother). (53)

If the lord of the 5th house is located in Amsas like "Gopur", in the Navamsha of a benefic planet, is aspected by a benefic planet, is itself a male planet & is associated with a male planet in the male Navamsha. the yoga indicates the first birth as of a good son. (54)

If the lord of the 5th house is located in a female sign, with a female planet, in a female house, the yoga indicates the first birth as of a daughter. In case the lord of the 5th house is located in the Navamsha etc. of a eunuch planet the child is a eunuch. (55)

The number of good points falling in the sign occupied by Jupiter or those in the 5th house tell the number of sons under the Ashtak varga system. but in the reckoning the points contributed by planets lords of the inimical or debilitation signs of the signicator or by a planet that is eclipsed should be ignored. (56) 143

If the lord of the 6th house is located in "Gopur" etc amsha aspected by the Sun, & if the lord of the 1st house is full of strength, the native helps his community members (also brothers & sisters of mother). (57)

If the lords of the 5th and the lagna are mutual friends, there is friendship between the native and his son. If they are mutual enemies, enmity between the two should be declared. If the two planets are neutral there is neutrality between the two. (58)
If the lords of the first and the 5th houses mutually aspect each other or they are located in the Navamsha of each other, the yoga indicates that the son will serve the father i.e. the native. (59)
If the lord of the 5th house aspects the lagna or is located in the lagna & if the lord of the lagna is located in the 5th house, the son carries out the orders of the father of the native. (60)
If the lord of the 5th house is located in 6th, 8th or 12th house and is aspected by the lord of the lagna & also by Mars & Rahu, the son is always opposed to the father i.e. to the native. (61)
If Mercury is in the 6th house aspected by a malefic planet, the native does not like sweet things. If Venus is in an inimical sign in the 6th house with Mercury, the native likes sour dishes. (62)

If the lord of the 3rd house occupies the 3rd house itself, the lord of the 5th is in the 4th house with a benefic planet in exaltation, the son feeds the father very well. (63) The 3rd house in the horoscope of any body is the 11th house of his son i.e. the arms of his son. If the lord of the 3rd house is in the 3rd, it will influence the 9th house—the house of the father in a deliberate manner & in case it is a benefic planet it would act to the advantage of the father. Similarly, if the lord of the 5th house is in the 4th with strong benefics it will influence the 10th house i.e. the 2nd house or the mouth of the father, which means the son will feed the father.

If the lord of the 5th house is located in the 9th house and is located with benefic planets & aspaced also by such planets, the native is always engaged in feeding others. (64) Charity of food articles is indicated by the fact that the 5th house is 9th from 9th & acts as 9th on the principle of "Bhavat bhavam". Another reason is the fact that the 5th house being second to the house of masses (4th) stands for the mouth of the public which is benefitted by good influence.
The principle should be applied to sons etc on the basis of their respective houses and significators. This science should be divulged to the theist & not to an atheist. (65)

The following should be considered from the 7th house:-
Marriage, wife, husband, pulses, curd, gur, milk, coming and going, urge for sex, urinal place and lost wealth. (1)

If the lord of the 5th house is located in the 8th house & is with the lord of the 8th, or is in its sign of debilitation, or in inimical sign, or is eclipsed, the disease in the belly is indicated. (67)

If Rahu, Moon are eclipsed by the rays of the Sun, the native gets his belly cut open. If Saturn is located in the lagna without any benefic aspect i.e. Moon in dark half is in association with Rahu and Sun, the native gets his belly severed by a weapon particularly if Moon is in degree to degree conjunction with the Sun. (20)
If the lord of the decante occupied by Saturn is located with or is aspected by Mars or is located in the sign or Navamsha of Mars, the native dies in battle. (27)
If Sun and Mars aspect each other & are located in each other's Navamsha, the native dies as a result of fight with another individual in a duel. (28)

If all the benefic planets are located in their sign of debilitation, or inimical sign or are eclipsed and are defeated in war (by Mars etc. having more northern declination) are located in the Navamshas of malefic planets & are in association with malefics, the man meets sudden death. (30)

If the planets Saturn, Rahu and Sun are located in malefic Shashti amsha (1/60th division) & Saturn is eclipsed by Sun & the three planets aspect the lord of the 8th house, the native meets sudden death. (31)
If Moon is located in a watery sign in the 6th house & the lord of the 6th house is also located in a watery sign aspected by Mercury, the native suffers from urinal troubles. (40)
If Moon is in the 6th and Saturn in the 8th house, a malefic in the 12th and the lord of the lagna is in the Navamsha of a malefic planet the native suffers from diseases of nose etc. (41)

If Venus is located in the 7th house, the native is overridden with sex, if it be Mercury there then he has affairs with another woman. If it be Jupiter he lives only with his wife, if Saturn he has affairs with a bad woman. If the lord of the 7th house is a benefic planet he has a good wife. (2)

If Mars is located in the 7th house, the native even though having many wives has affairs with other women and thereby destroys his family (brings bad name to it). If it is Sun the native has a family but is attached to many women. If the lords of the 2nd, 7th, & 6th house occupy the Ascendant along with Venus & are associated with malefics the native has bad ways & is attached to other women. If these are aspected by benefics it is not so. If the lords of the 6th and the 1st houses are located with malefics, then also the native has bad ways and is attached to other women. (3, 4)
If the lords of the 1st, 6th and 2nd are with malefics or if Saturn is in the 7th house with the lord of the 7th & malefics the native is atached to other women in his own family. (5)

If the lord of the 7th house is located with Rahu or Ketu & is aspected by malefics, the yoga is one of adultry. If the lords of the 10th. 2nd and 7th houses are located in the 10th, the yoga is again one of adultry. (6)

Even if one of the three planets i.e. lords of the tenth, 2nd, 7th is located in the 4th house the native resorts to adultery. If the lords of the 5th and the 7th houses are strong & are associated with or aspected by the lord of the 6th, the native has no progeny. If the two planets & the lord of the 6th occupy the 7th house aspected by a benefic he gets son from another woman. If the lord of the 7th house is located in the 2nd house, under the aspect of Mars the native gets son from another woman. (8)

If the lords of the 5th and the 9th houses along with the lord of the 7th house are located in 6th, 8th or 12th house and are neither in association with nor under aspect of a benefic, the man does not get a son even if he has many wives. (9)

If a weak (away from the Sun by not more than 72 degrees) Moon is located in the 7th house with a malefic planet, the native is adultrous. So also is the case if the lord of the 7th house is located in the lagna with a malefic. (10)
If the lord of the 5th house is located in the 7th, and the lord of the 7th house is with a malefic and Venus is weak, the wife of the native dies as a result of (loss etc of) pregnancy. (11)

160 If the 7th house is occupied by Venus in its sign of debilitation or if Moon is in its sign of debilitation in the 7th house, the wife dies by drowning. If the lord of the 7th house is located in the decantes going by the name of "Paash" & "Bhujang" (Ropet & serpent), the wife dies by hanging. (12)

If the lord of the 7th house is with Rahu and Mandi and is in decante going by the name of Bhujanga i.e. serpent, the wife dies by taking poison. If the lord of the 2nd house is located in the 2nd house itself & the lord of the 7th is also in its own sign in the 7th, the man has only one wife. (13) When the lords of the 2nd and the 7th are occupying their own signs in the 2nd and 7th houses respectively, the two houses would become strong. Since both of these houses stand for the longevity of wife, the first wife would be long living without necessitating a second marriage.
The number of planets located with the lords of the 2nd and the 7th houses give the number of wives. The number is also determined from the number of planets in association with the lord of the sign occupied by the lord of the 7th house. (14)
If the lord of the 7th house is very nice by virtue of being in retrogradation, exaltation etc., the man gets many wives, so also is the case when a strong Venus is in the Ascendant. (15)

Two marriages should be predicted if the lord of the lagna is located in the 8th house, the 7th house is occupied by a malefic & the lord of the 2nd is with a malefic. (16) It is easy to see that the malefic affliction to the 7th & 2nd houses & their lords leads to the death of the first wife & hence to the 2nd marriage. The author states that the location of the lord of lagna in 161 the 8th house also leads to the same result. This is apparantly based on the principle of "Bhavat bhavam" under which the first house being 7th to 7th would be treated as 7th and as such its destruction of the first wife & consequently to the 2nd marriage. (16)
Early death of wife should be predicted if the lord of the 7th house is with Saturn, Mars and Rahu & is located in a malefic Shashti amsha. (17)

If the lord of the 7th house is located in inimical sign or in its sign of debilitation with a benefic planet & there is a malefic planet in the 7th house, two marriages of the native should be predicted. (18)

If the significator of wife i.e. Venus is situated with a malefic planet & is located in its sign of debilitation or in its debilitation Navamsha & is aspected by a malefic planet the native marries twice. (19)

The planet that is strongest from among the significator of the 7th house, Moon, Mercury, Jupiter and Venus should be taken as the base for determination of the longevity of the partner in life, wife or husband as the case may be. (20)
If there are malefic planets in the 7th and 2nd houses and their lords are weak, the native loses his first wife & has to marry another lady. (21)

If malefics occupy the 7th and 8th houses and Mars is located in the 12th house & if the 7th house is not aspected by its own lord, the native loses his first wife and has to marry a second time. (22) 162

If both the 2nd & the 7th are occupied by many malefic planets & the lord of the 7th house is aspected by a malefic the native has to marry thrice, one after another, as a result of death of wives. (23)

If there are malefic planets in the Ascendant, the 2nd house or in the 7th and the lord of the 7th house is weak by being eclipsed or being in its sign of debilitation, the man has to marry thrice. (24)
If the lord of the 1st of the 7th house is in its sign of debilitation, or is eclipsed by the rays of the Sun, and is situated in malefic Shashti amsha, the native has to marry a second time. (25)

If the lord of the Navamsha occupied by the lord of the 7th house is located in turn in a Navamsha belonging to its enemy or to its sign of debilitation or is with the Sun and is situated in between malefics & aspected by malefics the native has to marry a second time. (26)

Similarly if the lord of the 2nd house or the lord of the Navamsha occupied by the significator (Venus) is in between malefics and so also are the 7th house and its lord the yoga should be considered as destructive of the first wife. (27)

If a strong Mercury is located in the 10th house from the lord of the 1st house and Moon is located (in strength) in the 3rd from the lord of the 7th house, the native lives with many wives. (28) Mercury in strength is not only a female planet in strength, but also a factor of plurality in strength. Located in 10th from the lord 163 of the lagna Mercury would make the traits of the lagna lord plural as it would throw its 3/4th aspect on it. Since the lagna is 7th to 7th, it represents 7th i.e. wife & hence wife would be made plural by the said yoga. Similarly Moon is also a female planet like Mercury in 10th (upchaya) Moon would also be in an upchaya house from the lord of the 7th & would denote gain of wives. For the relevance of upchaya houses to the problem of many wives see also shloka 30 &
31.

If the lord of the 12th and the 2nd houses are located in the 3rd house and are aspected by Jupiter or by the lord of the 9th house, the native has many wives. (29) The 12th house stands for विवाह according to the dictum " त्यागो भोगे विवाहेषु ". The 2nd also denotes marriage according to Maharshi Parashar vide shloka 9 chapter 22 bphs. Hence when the lords of these houses are located in the 3rd house—an upchaya (gain) house, the yoga would denote much gain of wives particularly when aspected by the best of benefics i.e. Jupiter & the priest for marriage & by another best of planets viz the lord of the 9th house. It would also be noted that the 3rd house is 2nd to 2nd and 4th to 12th i.e. very well placed from both. For this reason too the prospects of the 12th and the 2nd (marriage) would prosper.

If the lord of the 7th house is located in a kendra or a trine, in its sign of exaltation or in its own varga (decante etc) & in a sign of its friend & is associated with the lord of the 10th house, the native lives with many wives (at a time). (30)
If the lords of the 7th and the 11th houses are located together or they aspect each other & are located in a trine in strength, the yoga indicates that the native has many wives at a time. (31)
If the lord of the 9th is located in the 7th house & the lord of the 7th is in the 4th, the lord of the 7th & the 11th are in kendra, the native has many wives. (32)

Find out the lord of the Navamsha occupied by the lord of the 7th house. Then see the lord of the Navamsha occupied by that lord. If the latter Navamsha lord is in strength and is located in amsha such as the "Parvat" the man has a hundred wives. (33)
If the lord of the Shashti amsha (1/60th division) occupied by the lord of the sign occupied by the 2nd house, is strong & in Mridu amsha or Gopur amsha, the native has 2 hundred wives. (34)

Find out the lord of the Navamsha occupied by the significator of the 7th house. Then see the lord of the sign in which it is placed. The lord of the sign occupied by the latest lord if located in a kendra, in Mridu amsha or in Gopur amsha would give 300 wives to the native. (35)
If the lord of the 7th house is situated in "Gopur" amsha & the lord of the 10th house is in the 7th & the lord of the 2nd is also strong & in 2nd house the native has 10 wives. (36)

In this manner the wives of sons etc. should be considered.
If the lord of the 7th house is situated with a malefic planet, or the 7th house is occupied by a malefic or when the lord of the Navamsha occupied by the lord of the 7th house is a malefic planet, the native gets a bad wife. Similarly, one gets a bad wife if the 7th house & its lord are located in malefic Shashti amsha. (37 & 38)

If both the lord of the 7th house, and its significator are located in their sign of debilitation & in Navamsha of their debilitation sign and are devoid of benefic influence the native gets a bad wife. (39)
If the lord of the 7th house is with a benefic planet & also aspected by a benefic or if it is situated in between benefics the yoga indicates a chaste wife to the native. (40)
If the lord of the 7th house is located in the Navamsha of a benefic planet & so also is the signifier of the 7th house & the lord of the 10th house is strong, the native has a chaste wife. (41)

If Venus is in its sign of exaltation in a friendly sign, in the varga belonging to its own sign, in amsha such as "Gopur", in benefic Shashti amsha, & in Mridu amsha, the native's wife is chaste. (42)

If the lord of the 7th house is strong located with Jupiter or aspected by it, if the signifier of wife & the 7th house are similarly strong & influenced by Jupiter, the wife of the native is chaste. (43)

If Sun (Satvik planet) is lord of the 7th houe or if Venus lord of the 7th is aspected by benefics and the 7th is occupied by Jupiter, the wife of the native is religious and loyal to the husband. (44)

If the lord of the 7th house is located in kendra and is aspected by a benefic planet, & is located in a benefic Navamsha & a benefic sign, the wife of the native is chaste & loyal to the husband. (45)
If Sun is the lord of the 7th house, but is with a malefic in a malefic sign in the Navamsha of a malefic planet and is aspected by malefics, the wife is sinful. (46)

If Sun as the lord of the 7th house is strong, with benefics and located in the Navamsha sign of a benefic & is aspected by a benefic planet & is the friend of the lord of the lagna the wife is devoted to the husband. (47) One of the conditions for the loyality of the wife laid down is that the lord of the 7th house should be a friend of the lord of the lagna. This is generally not so as the two planets involved in the case of every Ascendant are mutually inimical. What is probably meant is that the lord of the 7th house should be a temporary friend of the lord of the lagna (see shloka 97 of chapter 1).
If the lord of the 7th house is located in the Navamsha of a malefic planet & is located in between malefic planets, the wife is adament, faulty, & adultrous. (48)

If Moon or Venus is the lord of the 7th house, & is located in a benefic Navamsha, or with a benefic planet or in its sign of exaltation, in its friends sign, or in Mridu amsha, the wife is virtuous & of good character. (49)

If the lord of the 7th house i.e. Mars with no strength, & located in malefic Shashti amsha etc, occupying its sign of debilitation, or an inimical sign or is eclipsed by the Sun, the wife of the native is of bad character. She has affairs with others & is curt towards her husband. (50)

If the lord of the 7th house is located in the varga of its friend or in its exalted varga, is associated with a benefic, is aspected by a benefic, & is strong by being in amshas like "Paravat" the wife even if fierce possesses the good qualities of her husband & is loyal to him. (51)

If the lord of the 7th house is Mercury (who easily takes upon itself the influence of others) associated with a malefic planet, is eclipsed i.e. located in the 8th house, is in between malefics, & is under the aspect of malefic planets, the wife of the native will act towards the destruction of her husband and will destroy the whole family (through opposition to family traditions). (52)

If the lord of the 7th house is Mercury, it is strong, located in its friendly or exaltation varga, or in amsha such as "Gopur", the wife is one who has purified her body through vows & fasting. She will also have good son & will have comforts of life. (53)

If Venus is the lord of the 7th house, & is located with a malefic, or is with a planet in its sign of debilitation, or occupies its own sign of debilitation, or is eclipsed by the Sun, & is in a malefic Shashti amsha, the wife would be like a prostitute, hard & a thief. (54)

If Venus is strong as the lord of the 7th house, is situated with a benefic, is in the Navamsha of a benefic, is in the varga of a friend or in its own exaltation varga, is in its own sign, is in Mridu amsha, the wife is garrulous, but blessed with sons & virtuous. (55)

If Saturn owns the 7th house & is situated with a malefic, is in the Navamsha of its sign of debilitation, in its debilitation sign, in an inimal sign, under aspect of malefic planets & in the Navamsha of malefic planets the wife of the native will appear too old in age. will be of bad character, and a blot on the good name of the family. (56)

If Saturn owns the 7th house, is strong, under aspect of benefics, particularly under aspect of benefics, particularly under aspect of Jupiter, the wife will be engaged in the unselfish service of others, she will be devoted to brahmins & gods, follower of Vedanta, religious, dutiful, & of good moral character. (57)

If Rahu or Ketu is in the 7th house, under the aspect of malefics, in malefic Navamsha, the wife will be adultrous, sinful, of bad character, defamed by people, curt & even administering poison to her husband. (58)

If the lord of the 7th house and of the first house are located in the lagna close to each other in degreecal position, the native gets married early in boyhood. The same will be the result if natural benefic planets are located close to both the Ascendant and the 7th house. (59) This is an important shloka of much use and demand in actual life. The lagna has two roles to play: one is that of "self" & the other as of the 7th house on the principle of "Bhavat Bhavam". The lord of the house of marriage connected with self i.e. the lagna obviously signifies easy acquisition of marriage. The placement of benefic planets near the two houses of marriage would also boost these houses & thereby bring about marriage at early date.

If the lagna, the 2nd house, & the 7th house are occupied by benefic planets & are in benefic vargas, and the lords of these houses are under benefic aspect, marriage of the native takes place in early boyhood. (60)

169 If the lord of the 7th house is located in the amsha "Paravat" & the lord of the 2nd house is strong & Mridu amsha is occupied by the lord of the lagna, the sages say, marriage takes place in early boyhood. (61)

If Venus is in the 7th house or is located in any of the houses 3rd, 6th, 10th or 11th or if it is in the 2nd house & the lord of the lagna is in association with or under the aspect of benefics, the luck of the native shines after his marriage. (62)

If the signi.icator of the 7th house is Venus, lord of the 7th house, lord of the 2nd house, lord of the 1st house are located in 6th, 8th or 12th house, in their Navamsha of debilitation, or in inimical Navamsha or are eclipsed by the Sun are in association with malefics, the financial prospects of life suffer soon after marriage. (63)

If the significator of the 7th house i.e. Venus along with the other three planets mentioned in the previous shloka are located in malefic amshas but are located with benefics, are under benefic aspect, the native meeting financial loss soon after marriage again gets good financial prospects. (64)

If the lord of the 7th house is with a malefic planet in a trine & the significator of the 7th house (Venus) is also with a malefic or is in the 2nd house or the 10th house the prospects of the native rise much after his marriage. (65)

If the lord of the 7th house is located in the 10th house with a malefic planet, or it is in 2nd house or the 9th with malefics & is in the Navamsha of malefics & aspected by malefics and the 7th house is occupied by malefics, the prospects shine much after marriage of the native. (66)
The same line of thinking should be adopted in the question relating to the early or late acquisition of sons i.e. malefic influence on the relevant factors has a delaying effect. (67)

If the lord of the 7th house is weaker than the lord of the lagna & is located in the Navamsha of its inimical sign or is eclipsed, is in the Navamsha of its sign of debilitation or is with a planet in debilitation, the wife comes from a low family. (68)

If the lord of the 7th house is stronger than the lord of the 1st house & is located in the Navamsha of a benefic planet, is under the aspect of a benefic planet, or is located in "Vaisheshik" amsha or in the highest degree of its exaltation, the wife comes from a very high family. (69) The nativity with Aquarius Ascendant sometimes offers a good example of a man marrying a girl much above his status, particularly when Sun is undar benefic influence, for the reason that Sun, the lord of the 7th house (wife), is very much higher in status to Saturn, lord of the lagna, (native) who is classed as most inferior in scale. Here is an example of a man belonging to upper middle class who married a princess belonging to one of the erstwhile states of India. The data has been withheld for obvious reasons. It would be 171 seen that the royal Sun is not only the lord of the 7th house representing wife but is also fully aspected by a very strong royal benefic Moon, who it would be noted is the dispositor of two benefics viz Venus and Mercury. There is thus benefic influence on the already royal Sun of as many as 3 benefics. Again mark the fact that Jupiter occupying the house of wife is not only a benefic himself but is a planet of value being lord of two houses of value viz of 2nd & the 11th. Such an excellent Jupiter is the dispositor of the most strong and royal Moon. Hence the influence of Jupiter on the 7th house and of Moon on the lord of the 7th house gave a princess in marriage. The significator of marriage viz Venus is also located in between the royal influence of Moon on one side of it and of its dispositor Jupiter on the other. No wonder then for marriage of a layman with a princess.

If the lord of the lagna is weaker than the lord of the 7th house & is with malefics or in the Navamsha of its sign of debilitation, or located in the 8th house or is going to the Navamsha sign of its sign of debilitation. the native himself is of an inferior status than that of his wife. (70)

If the lord of the lagna is stronger than the lord of the 7th house, & is located in the Navamsha of a sign that constitutes one leading to the exaltation sign, or is in the highest degree of exaltation, is in a kendra, or trine, or is with benefics the native himself is superior in status to that of his wife. (71)

172 The comparison should be carried out as between the lord of the lagna on one side and the lord of the 7th house or that of the 2nd from the 7th house. If the two sides are equally balanced the status of the wife and the husband is equal. It denotes a wife of good character and devoted to the husband. (72)

If the lord of the 7th house is enemy to the lord of the lagna, the relation of wife will be inimically disposed towards the native. If they are friends the other members of the family of wife will be friendly towards the native. (73)
If the lord of the lagna is inimical to the lord of the 7th, the members of the family of the native too will be inimical. If friend, the result will be the reverse. (74)
In order to decide about the colour of wife, the strongest of the sign in the 7th house, its lord and Venus will give the result through the colour of the influence falling on them. (75)

If the above noted factors are aspected by Jupiter or Venus the wife will bebeautifuland of good qualities. If aspected by malefics & associated with malefics she would have evil qualities and will be ugly in looks. (76)

Or the lagna of the wife will be the sign occupied by the lords of the 3 factors for the partner viz the sign in the 7th house. the sign occupied by the lord of the 7th house his exaltation or debilitation sign or it will be the sign 5th or 9th to the 3 signs arrived at by the three factors mentioned above. In case the sign thus arrived at is not suitable from the point of view of getting sons (as determined from the 5th house etc) it may be other rashi as mentioned below (78)

In case the lagna thus arrived at for the wife is Taurus, Leo or Virgo, it gives very few sons. If however there is benefic influence on these 3 signs, there will be sons with good qualities. (79) The idea behind the method stated in shloka 77 for finding out the lagna of the wife is to find out the predominating influence on the factors that represent wife. Since under the fundamental principle of astrology all problems have to be tackled by a consideration of the house concerned, its lord and the significator involved, we think we should determine the dominant planet & its sign that influence the 3 fundamental factors. We suggest our own horoscope as an illustration. We will tackle the problem of the sign of our younger & elder brother. Sign in the 3rd house is Virgo. This 3rd house, its lord and Mars the significator of younger brothers have to be taken as the basic influenced factors. Virgo or the sign of Saturn may be the brothers sign, the lord of 3rd Mercury is influenced by Jupiter, Sun, Mars & Venus. It may give a sign belonging to any one of these. The significator Mars is influenced by Sun, Mercury, Jupiter and Venus. It may give the sign of any of these. Since Mercury is involved in all the three cases & is thus dominant, the younger brother should be born with Virgo as his Ascendant, which is actually the case. Similarly in the case of elder brother the sign in 174 the 11th house, Moon & Saturn aspecting it, Leo in which the
significator of elder brothers viz Jupiter is situated or Venus who is
influencing Jupiter through the 9th aspect of Ketu aspected by
Venus may give their sign. Since Venus has the predominent
influence on the relevant factors, Taurus—the sign of Venus in the
11th house—wins. Hence Taurus is the lagna of the elder brother
which is actually the case.

If Sun occupies the 7th house, the man cohabits with a stirile
woman, if Moon is there he cohabits with a maid servant. If it is
Mars cohabitation is with a woman in monthly course or a stirile
woman. (80)

If the 7th is occupied by Mercury the cohabitation is with a pros-
titute, a low woman or one belonging to the trader community, If it
is Jupiter it is with a Brahmin woman, if it is Venus the cohabita-
tion is with a pregnant woman. (81)

If the 7th house is occupied by Saturn, Rahu or Ketu the
cohabitation is with a lowcaste woman or one in monthly course.
In the case of occupation by Rahu it is with a pregnant woman &
in the case of Saturn it is with a black woman with hunch
back. (82)

By the location of Sun etc in the 4th house, the same results
regarding cohabitation with the type of women stated would
follow. The nature of conveyance and the type of residence should
be decided on the basis of the location of Sun etc in the 4th house
(see next shloka). (83)

If Sun is in 4th, the residence is in a jungle, If Moon, it is in places of habitation. If Mars, it is a cottage; if Mercury, it is a pleasure resort, if Jupiter, it is temple, If Venus, it is a watery place; if Saturn, it is a place infested with lions; if it is Rahu or Ketu, it is a place infested with elephants. (84)
If all the four kendras (i.e. the 1st, 4th, 7th and the 10th houses) and their lords are afflicted by male planets, the native has sexual contact with quadrupeds. (85)
If kendras and trines (1, 4, 7, 10, 5 & 9) are occupied by malefic planets, or if Saturn is with Mandi and a malefic planet, the native cohabits like an animal. (86)
The native engages himself in the sexual act like an animal, if Sun, Saturn and Mars occupy the 4th house. The same result should be there if Rahu is in the 7th house and Mars in 4th. (87)
If the lord of the sign occupied by Saturn is aspected by Venus, or is in the sign of Mars or is with Venus, the native kisses the private part of the woman. (88)
Similarly the said act of kissing should be predicted from the lord of the 2nd house (i.e. by Saturn lord of second influencing Venus). (89)
If he lord of the 10th house is aspected by Saturn or is located in the sign of Mars or is in association with Venus, the native engages himself in that act of kissing. (90)

If the lord of the lagna is located in bad signs such as its sign of debilitation the act of the said kind will be performed by the 176 native. The same result will follow by the debilitation etc of the lord of the 2nd house. (91)

If Mars is in the 7th house, the wife has small breasts, if Saturn or Rahu is there she has long breasts, if Sun is there the breasts are hard and pointing upwards. If the rest of the planets occupy the 7th house, she has, very good and big sized breasts. (92)
If the lord of the 7th house is with one malefic planet, the wife has abnormal type of breasts, irrespective of the fact whether the said lord is a malefic or a benefic. (93)
The wife has normal sized breasts if the lord of the 7th house is with two benefics. If with malefics the opposite is the result (she has very small breasts). (94)
If the lord of the 7th house is located with benefics, in a watery house & in a watery sign, aspected by Jupiter, the wife has abnormally big sized breasts. (95)
If Sun or Mars is the lord of the 7th house and is situated with Saturn, Mandi or Rahu in the Navamsha of a malefic planet it is an indication of the private part of the wife being long in size. (96)
If the lord of the 7th house is Jupiter or Venus & is located in the Navamsha sign of a benefic, the wife has a normal sized private part, if in the Navamsha of a malefic it is long sized. (97)
177 If Saturn, Moon or Mercury is the lord of the 7th house, the private part of wife is short sized. (98)

If the lord of the 7th house occupies a watery sign & the significator i.e. Venus too is in a watery sign, the 7th house contains a watery sign aspected by Moon, strong in Paksha strength (i.e. at or near its maximum distance from the Sun), or if Moon occupies a watery sign in the 7th house & is aspected by Venus located in a watery sign or by Mercury located in a watery sign, the wife of the native will have plenty of raja i.e. liquid matter in her private part. (99-100)
If full Moon is in the 7th house in the sign or Navamsha of a watery planet and is aspected by a Jupiter located in a watery sign, there is wetness in the private part all the time. (101)
If Venus is occupying its highest degree of exaltation in the Navamsha of its exaltation sign & is in a watery sign & located with Sun, the wetness is profuse at the time of cohabitation. (102)

If the lord of the 7th house is located in a dry sign (5, 6, 7, 8, 11 & 12) & there is a dry sign in the 7th house aspected by a dry planet (see shloka 130 of chapter 17) the private part of the wife is not wet (i.e. it is dry). (103)
If the lord of the 7th house is in the sign of a malefic planet & in between malefics, or with malefics & under aspect of malefics, the private part of the wife is dry. (104)
If Mercury as the lord of the 7th house is aspected by a strong Jupiter & also by the lord of the 2nd house, the native eats pulses, curd, & ghee. (105)
If the lord of the 7th house is aspected by Jupiter & is located in a benefic Navamsha, aspected by Mercury located in a benefic Navamsha, the native enjoys pulses, curd, ghee etc. (106)
If Venus is located in the 7th house & is aspected by a very strong Moon, is not associated with or aspected by malefics, the man enjoys pulses, curd, ghee etc. (107)
If Sun or Mars is lord of the 7th house & is aspected by a benefic planet or is placed in the 2nd house, the man sometimes enjoys curd and pulses etc. (108)
If a malefic planet occupies the 7th house & the lord of the 7th house is with malefics or in a malefic Shashti amsha, the native seldom enjoys ghee & pulses etc. (109)
If Moon or Jupiter is the lord of the 7th house and is located in a watery sign or Navamsha, or is aspected by a watery planet, the native enjoys milk and its products. (110)
If the lord of the 7th house occupies the Navamsha and is under the aspect of a benefic planet, or is located in a benefic Navamsha, the native enjoys gur, milk products etc. (111)

If there are many malefic planets in the 7th house, or if there are malefic planets in the 6th and the 8th houses located in malefic Shashti amsha, the native will suffer from urinary troubles.
(112)

From the 8th house the following should be examined :-
Longevity, death, rectum, mode of death, enjoyment of food, service, being bitten and defeat.
If the lord of the 8th house is located in the 12th with malefics the native gets short life. If the lord of the 8th is in the 6th under influence of malefics then also he is short lived. (2)

If the lord of the 8th house is located in its own sign in the 8th, the great thinkers declare it as a yoga for long life; so also is the result, if the lord of the 8th is located in the 7th in its own sign, in the sign of a friend or in its sign of exaltation. (3)

If the lord of the Navamsha occupied by the lord of the 9th house is with Moon or Venus & is afflicted by malefic, the native cohabits with the wife of his Guru or if the lord of the 9th house is in its sign of debilitation, its Navamsha occupied by it belongs to Venus & is located with Venus, the same results follows. (4)

If Moon is weak in Paksha strength i.e. within 72 degrees from the Sun & is located in the Navamsha of Venus, the man cohabits with the wife of his Guru. Or if the lord of the 9th house is in its sign of debilitation & Venus occupies the Navamsha sign of the lord of the 9th the same result follows. (5)

If the lord of the 9th house is located with a benefic planet through its Navamsha, or if its lord is located in the Vaisheshik amsha & does not occupy a malefic Shashti amsha (1/60th division) the native is strongly entrenched in religion & morality.
If Jupiter or Venus occupies its own or a friendly Navamsha & 192 the lord of the 9th house & a benefic planet in strength, the native becomes the head of a religious institution. (7)
If the lord of the 9th house occupies the Navamsha sign of Jupiter, Venus or Mercury and is aspected by benefics & is located in between benefics, the native becomes religious. (8)

If a benefic planet occupies the 9th house, but is located there in the Navamsha belonging to a malefic planet & is occupying a malefic Shashti anisha (1/60th division), the native resorts to religion through hypocrisy. (9)

If natural benefic planets are located in the 6th, 7th and 8th houses & are associated with benefics, & there are natural malefics in the 3rd, 6th & 11th houses, the native enjoys full longevity. (10)

If the 9th house is occupied by a malefic planet, & if the lord of the 9th house is located with a malefic, is in between malefics or is located in malefic Shashti amsha, the native becomes sinful. (11)

If Rahu and Saturn occupy the 9th house, & the Navamsha of a malefic planet & if the two are aspected by Gulik & the lord of the 9th house is located in a malefic Navamsha, the native engages in very cruel deeds. (12)

182 If there are three planets in the 8th house & each of them is either in its sign of exaltation, or sign of its friend or in its own house and if the lord of the lagna is strong, the native enjoys long life. (13)

One is benefitted from his father for long, if the lord of the 9th house, occupies amsha like "Paravat" along with the significator (Sun) & the two are located in the Navamsha belonging to their exaltation signs or signs of their friends. (14)

If malefics occupy the 6th, 8th & the 12th houses, and the lord of the lagna is weak & there is no benefic influence on any of the factors stated above, the man is short lived & is without progeny. (15 & 16)
If both, the lord of the 9th house & its significator (Sun) are located with malefics & are aspected by malefics or are located in between malefic planets. the yoga indicates trouble to father. (17)

The father of the native will suffer much, if the 9th house, its lord & its significator (Sun) are located in their respective signs of debilitation & are of Navamsha influenced by Saturn, Mandi & Rahu. (18)

Longevity is of three types: upto 32 years, it is called "short", from 32 to 69, it is middle and beyond 69 it is called "long" (19) If the lord of the lagna is enemy of the Sun the longevity is short. (20) If it is neutral the longevity is middle; if it is friend, the longevity is long, one lives till middle age if the lord of the lagna is weak, Jupiter is in kendra or trine & there are natural malefics in the 6th, 8th & 12th houses. If a benefic occupies a kendra or trine & Saturn is strong in kendra or trine, malefics are situated in 6th or 8th house, the yoga gives middle longevity. (23)

People born in a yoga that gives only short life; the main ruling period of the "Vipat" tara i.e. the planet lord of the 3rd asterism from that occupied by Moon at birth which ends life. In the case of people with middle longevity, death occurs in the main period of "Pratyari" tara i.e. lord of the asterism from that occupied by Moon. (24) For people born in A yoga conferring long life the main period of "Vadha" tara i.e. lord of the asterism from that occupied by Moon at least ends life. Thus death should be predicted after determining the type of longevity short, middle or long. (25)

If both the lords of the 1st and the 8th houses are weak & are influenced by Mars & the lord of the 6th house, the native dies in battle field or by weapons. (26) The mode of death has to be seen from the influences on the 1st & 8th houses and their lords. We would study for example the following birth chart of Sheikh Mujiburrehman who was shot dead by his enemies along with many other members of his family. 184 It would be noted that the 6th house is one of injury. Its lord is Mars who is also a planet of injury. Add to it the fact that Mars is lord of the sign occupied by Ketu & then you have an idea of how injurious Mars can prove. It can give death by injury if it influences the factors stated at the beginning of this note. Here if you know that according to Maharshi Parashar Rahu aspects i.e. influences the house located 9th from it you will see that the 8th house of the birth chart, showing manner of death is influenced by it. Since Rahu is a shadowy planet & conveys the influence of the planet associated with it, it throws on the 8th house the killing & injury influence of Mars thereby showing death by injury. The influence of Mars is felt on each side of the 1st house & the house containg Mercury, the lord of the 8th house. Thus the influence of Mars & Ketu is falling on all factors denoting mode of death. Since Mars is lord of the 10th & 3rd houses from the 4th, it brought about death by the deliberate action of some member of the public denoted by the 4th house. The mode of death is indicated by the nature of influence falling on the 1st & 8th house or their lords. In the case under consideration, the influencing planets are Mars & the lord of the 6th house, each of which is an injury planet. Hence death through injury by weapons represented by Mars. If the lords of the 8th and the 1st house are located in the 6th house along with Rahu, Ketu & Saturn, then in the main ruling period of the lord of the 8th & the sub-period of the lord of the 1st or vice versa death of the native takes place through thieves or weapons. (27)

If the lord of the 1st and 8th houses are located with the lord of the 4th house, death of the native is caused by a conveyance. If the two are with Jupiter death is through loss of appetite. Death also takes place through loss of appetite if the lord of the 1st house & Jupiter are located in the 6th house. (28)

If the lord of 1st, 4th houses and Jupiter are together, death takes place through loss of appetite. If the lords of the 1st, 4th & the 2nd houses are together then also death takes place through loss of appetite. (29)

If the lord of the 9th house is located with the lord of the 3rd house, & is under the aspect of a benefic, is with a benefic or is in the Navamsha of a benefic planet the career of the native is boosted by the brother of the native. (30)

If the lords of the 1st and 2nd houses are located with Saturn, death takes place by consumption of poison. If the two i.e. the lords of the 1st and 2nd house are with Rahu or Ketu & located in 6th, 8th or 12th house the man dies by being hanged. (31)

If the lord of the 6th house is located with Rahu, Ketu and Saturn, the native dies at the hands of some wild animal. If the lord of 6th is with Jupiter the death is through an elephant. If it is with Moon it is caused by some horse. (32)

If the lord of the 6th house & Saturn are located with the Sun, the death of the native takes place through the horns of an animal. If the lord of the 6th & Saturn are with Mars the fear of death is from a dog. The location of Saturn in the 6th house in signs other than its exaltation sign, or its own sign and without the company of a benefic also leads to fear of death through a dog. (33)

If the lord of the 6th house is in "Sambandha" (by mutual exchange, mutual aspect. location in one place etc). with the lord of the 9th house, one gets luck through his enemies. The same result follows if the lord of the 9th house is located in the 9th with any of the lords of the 6th, 8th or the 12th house. (34)

If Moon is located in the 8th house along with Rahu and Saturn & is weak in Paksha strength i.e. is located within 72 degrees from the Sun, the native suffers from epilepsy. Moon in such a condition also gives trouble from the souls of the dead and from water. (35)

If a weak Moon (as defined in shloka 35) is located in the 8th house with Mars, Rahu & Saturn, even then the results stated in shloka 35 follow. If these are located in any other bad house i.e. 6th or 12th, then the man dies of epilepsy or of trouble from the souls of the dead. (36)

If the 9th house and its lord is associated with or aspected by Jupiter & Venus and the lords of the Ascendant and the 2nd house are located in the 3rd house (one of the bad houses). The native gets fortune again after having once lost it. (37)

If Sun is in 6th or 8th house in its sign of debilitation and aspected by malefics the man dies as a result of punishment by government and so does his father. He also suffers financial loss as a result of the said punishment. (38)

187 If the 9th or 10th house from the 1st is occupied by Mars and aspected by malefics, the yoga indicates death of the brother of the mother. If such a Mars is with Saturn it indicates death of the son. If the said Mars is with Moon & malefic, the death of the mother takes place. (39)

If Sun is with Mars in the 9th or 10th house, and is aspected by a malefic, there is early death of father. If both the lagna and Moon are afflicted by two malefics the native meets his death in early childhood. (40)

If at the time of birth the Moon is eclipsed or is with "Parivesh" & is aspected by malefics, it gives sudden death. If the asterisms Chitra, Uttraphalguni, or Purvashadha are located in the Ascendant degree or in the degree occupied by Moon and the Moon is eclipsed or under Parivesh, it is dangerous to the life of mother, the son & the maternal uncles. (41) Parivesh is one of the nine "Upgrahas" viz (1) Kal, (2) Parivesh, (or Paridhi), (3) Dhoom, (4) Ardhyam, (or Ardh prahar), (5) Yam ghantak, (or Yam kantak), (6) Indra dhanu, (7) Gulik or Mandi, (8) Yati patak, (or Vyatipat), (9) . (Upketu).

If the lord of the 10th house or that of the 9th is located in "Devloka" division, or in amsha called "Paravat" under aspect of benefics, the man is established well in the realization of the Supreme. (42)

If Mars located in the 7th or 8th house is aspected by malefics the native dies in early age. If Mars is in the 3rd along with some malefic & also aspected by a malefic, the yoga indicates the early death of younger brothers. (43)

If Moon is located in the 7th house along with a malefic and is also aspected by a malefic the yoga indicates early death of mother. If Sun is similarly situated, it indicates death of father. If Mars. Saturn and Venus are in the 7th, it indicates death of son. (44)
If the Ascendant or its lord is aspected by the lord of the 9th house, & the lord of the 9th is located in a kendra or trinal house, the native performs great acts of charity. (45)

If Moon and Sun are in the 1st house and malefic planets in the 12th house, and these are without the aspect of a benefic planet, the native dies in infancy. If Sun is in the 7th & Moon in the 1st house with a malefic, the yoga indicates early death of the son. (46)

If Sun and Moon are in the 12th house without the aspect of benefics the native becomes blind. If one of them is in the 6th and the other in 12th without benefic aspect the man is blind by one eye. (47)

If Sun and Moon are in the 12th and the lord of the 12th in the 1st house, the yoga indicates destruction of body. Similar is the result if Jupiter is located in 12th or 8th with malefics and under the aspect of malefics. (48)

If the lord of the 1st house is strong, but the lords of the 4th and the 9th houses are weak and occupy the 8th house, there will be death of father and the mother at the time of the birth of the native. (49)

If the lord of the 3rd house along with Moon is located in 6th, 8th or 12th house, the native drinks the milk of women other than his own i.e. his mother dies soon after his birth. If the lord of the 9th house and its significator i.e. Sun are located in 6th, 8th or 12th house, the father does not see a son. (50)

If the two planets i.e. the lord of the 9th house and Sun are located in a trine, the yoga indicates good comfort from the son. The location of the lord of 9th, Sun, & Saturn in the 6th house indicates the death of father during the night. (51)

If the planets—the lord of the 9th house the Sun & Saturn in 6th house—are located there with the lord of the 6th house then too death is in night time. If the yoga does not include Moon the death is during day time. The ayana—north or south in which mother dies—should be determined from the planets in the 4th house. (52) If there are no planets in the 4th house death takes place in the time indicated by the sign occupied by the lord of the 4th house. If there are more than 2 planets in the 4th house the ayana at death of mother shold be determined by the strongest of them all. (53)

If the lord of the 9th house is located in a kendra or a trinal house and is aspected by the lord of the 10th house, or is located in its highest degree of exaltation, the native gets articles in charity. (54)

If the Sun & Moon are in kendras, in movable signs, the son will not have opportunity to light the pyre of the parents. If they are in kendra & in common sign, there will be delay in the lighting of the pyres. (55)
If a natural benefic occupies the 9th house, & the 9th house has Sambandha or link (by mutual aspect etc) with Jupiter, the lord of the 9th is in Mridu amsha, the native is devoted to his Guru. (56)
If there are many malefic planets in the 8th house, disease on or near the rectum should be declared, not however, when there is benefic influence on the 8th house. (57)
The native leads a comfortable life, if the 8th house is occupied by or aspected by benefics. If there is influence of malefics on the 8th, one eats coarse food; otherwise, refined type. (58)

If the lord of the 8th house is located with malefics, is aspected by malefics, is located in between malefics or if the sign of a malefic is in the 8th house, the native often meets defeat in his undertakings. (59)

If there is influence of benefic planets on the 8th house there is no defeat for the native. If the sign in the 8th house is a movable one, & the lord of the 8th is also in a movable sign the native dies away from his home. (60)

In case Saturn is located in movable sign & in a movable Navamsha the death takes away from home. If there is a fixed sign in the 8th house, the lord of the 8th house is also in a fixed sign, or a fixed Navamsha, Saturn too is in a Navamsha belonging to a fixed sign, the native dies in his own home. If the 8th & its lord are in common signs, the death is on the way. (62)

From the 9th house of the horoscope the following should be considered, Guru, prospects in life, father, grandsons, compassion, tapas, income, hips, mind, family members, charity yoga, boss, uncles. If the 9th house is associated with benefic planets, the relations etc mentioned get benefitted. Otherwise these suffer. (1-2)

If the significator (Sun) is located in amshas like "Gopur" is aspected by the lord of the 9th house, & is neither associated with nor aspected by malefics, the native enjoys comforts from a long living father. (16)

If a natural beneflc planet located in the 9th house and the lord of the 9th house are located with enemies or are occupying their signs of debilitations or if these are located in malefic Shashti amshas (1/60th division) the yoga indicates throuble to father. (19)

Trouble to father should also be predicted, if the lord of the Navamsha occupied by the lord of the Navamsha belonging to the lord of the 9th house is located in the Navamsha of its sign of debilitation or to a malefic planet. (20)
If the lord of the 9th house is much stronger than the lord of the Ascendant and the significator i.e. the Sun is aspected by benefics, the native lives under the control of his father. (21)

If the Ascendant sign of the native is the same as the one 8th from the Ascendant of the father and if the lord of the 8th sign of the father is in the Ascendant of the native, the native attends to all the ceremonies connected with the death of the father. (22)

One born in the Ascendant belonging to a sign located in the 10th house of his father has qualities like his father. If born with an Ascendant sign identical to that of the Ascendant sign of the father one depends on the finances of his father. (23)

One born in a lagna having the sign falling in the 6th house of his father's birth chart is inimical to his father. One born if the signs falling in the 9th, 11th & 2nd house of his father's birth chart is obedient to his father. (24)
A native born in any of the three asterisms falling in 8th sign in his father's birth chart, is inimically disposed to his father & so also is his son so inimically disposed. (25)
If the lords of the 9th & the 3rd houses are located in the 3rd or the 9th house, and are in strength by being in their exaltation signs, the natives (father & the native) are good moral people. (27)

If the lord of the 9th house is aspected by Jupiter and Venus, the 9th house is aspected by the lord of the lagna, but if the lord of the 9th is located in a malefic Shashti amsha, the yoga is indicative of a great set back in fortune. But if the lord of the lagna is in 9th & the lord of 9th in lagna, or the lord of 9th is in 11th, the native attains good luck again if there is mutual link (or Sambandha) between the lords of the 11th and the 9th house. (38-39)

If in addition to Bhagya yogas for good luck or Rajyogas for affluence and power there is Dan yoga or yoga for charity, the yoga for charity works in actual practice. In cases where there is no Bhagya yoga or Rajyoga how can the charity yoga work. It is only people who are lucky and affluent can help charity. (47-48)
If the lord of the Ascendant is in the 11th house, the lord of the 10th is strong, and aspected by the lord of the Ascendant, the native gets charity from others. (52)

If the lord of the 5th house is located in the 9th house, & is associated with the lord of the 10th or the 9th house & is aspected by the lord of the 1st house, the native gets articles in charity.
(53)
Actions. ruling powers, fame, rain, living away, acts of public utility, honour, profession, knees & servants should be considered from the 10th house. (1)

If the lord of the 10th house is weak and under the influence of malefics, the yoga indicates frustrations in actions. When the lord of the 10th house. Jupiter and Mercury are strong the native is engaged in the service of others. (2)
These three planets. when strong and aspected by natural benefics, make the native particularly engage himself in acts of helping public causes. If, however, these are in 6th, 8th, or 12th house. badly aspected, there is absence of such acts. (3)

If the lord of the 10th house, or the lord of the Navamsha occupied by it or the lord of the sign occupied by it is located in the 8th house, the native gets devoid of acts of public utility if Rahu or Sun is in the 10th house. One has sacred baths in the Ganges. (4)

If in the Pisces in the 10th house, there is Mars with benefics, one gets liberation or moksha. If Jupiter and a strong Moon are occupying a watery sign in the 10th house one bathes in the sacred waters of the Ganges. (5)
If Jupiter occupies the 10th house, and Venus occupies its sign of exaltation in any kendra, one gets purified by a sacred bath in the Ganges. (6)
If Mercury is in the 12th house, and the lord of the 12th house is in his sign of exaltation, the native has meritorious results enabling him to have the said sacred baths. (7)

212 If the lord of the 10th house is a natural benefic planet, & is located in its sign of exaltation, or in the sign of friend or in its own varga & influences the lord of the 12th house by association or aspect, the native spends on legitimate moral items of expenditure. (8)

If the lord of the 10th is in the 10th in Gopur etc amsha the man engages himself in acts of renovation of old (sacred) places wells & tanks. He does so if the lord of the 10th is situated in Mridu amsha under benefic aspect & under the aspect of the lord of the 9th house. (10)

If the lord of the sign occupied by Moon is with a benefic, or is lying in between benefics or is in the Navamsha sign of benefics, the native has good fame. (21)

If the said lord of the decante is in its sign of exaltation. the abode after death is of a high order; if it is in its sign of debilitation, it is a low type abode; if it is of a middling type, the next abode too is of that type. (22)

If Jupiter or a benefic planet occupies the 10th house & the lord of the 10th house is in association with or under the aspect of benefics or is situated in between benefics the native is of quick understanding and honoured in life. (27)

A man is devoid of honour, if a malefic planet occupies the 10th house, which is aspected by a malefic & the lord of the 10th house is in its sign of debilitation or in the malefic sign or Navamsha. (28)

If the lord of the 12th house is located in its highest degree of exaltation & is aspected by the lord of the 9th house, the material of the bed is ebbedded with jewels & precious stones. (30)

If a benefic planet occupies the 10th house and in Horary astrology the question relates to "eating", the answer should be given that he or she will have his or her desire fulfilled. In cases where the 10th house is occupied by malefics, the yoga indicates the weakness of knees. (33)

If 4 planets are together in any place other than a kendra and if the lord of the sign occupied by these four planets is located in a kendra or a trinal house. Sanyas yoga is constituted. Sanyas yoga is also constituted if 4 planets are together in a kendra. (1)

If Saturn alone aspects the lord of the lagna & the lord of the lagna aspects Saturn & the lord of the lagna is weak Sanyas yoga is constituted. (2)

If Sun occupies the decante of Saturn and is aspected by Saturn, this yoga is constituted. Similarly Sanyas yoga is formed if Moon is located in the Navamsha of Saturn or if she is located in the Navamsha of Mars & is aspected by Saturn. (3)

If the lord of the house in which the Sanyas yoga is formed is with Rahu in a malefic Navamsha or is with Gulik, the Sanyas yoga is cancelled, if the planets afflicted are other than benefics. Based on this principle the location of 4 planets in any kendra would have the influence of the four planets on the lagna. Since the association of 4 planets is generally of a "Separative" character in view of the inclusion of one or more of the seperative planets, Sun, Saturn, Rahu, Mandi, etc the influence of the 4 planets gathered together in a kendra will be one of separation on the lagna which will have the effect of separating one from the traits of the 1st house, viz wealth and the place of birth, there is some justification in the yoga in question.

(20 & 21)
