If in any birth chart there are planets occupying their sign of exaltation, the native becomes a king of kings, ruler over many territories. If there are only five planets in exaltation and there is Jupiter in strength in the Ascendant, the native becomes a king. (1)
If the Ascendant is Aquarius and Venus is in exaltation & there are in all four planets in exaltation, but are not occupying any debilitation Navamsha or cruel 1/60th part of the sign even then the native becomes a king. (2)

If Moon occupies its sign of exaltation in the Ascendant and there are in all 6 planets in exaltation, the native becomes a king. If all planets are occupying their sign of exaltation anywhere in the horoscope, then also the native becomes a king. In case all the planets are located in their own signs the native though not a king is equal in status to a king. (3)
If 3 planets occupy their Mool Trikona signs or if 3 planets are in friendly signs in retrogression and the rest are located in exaltation without occupying their debilitation Navamsha the native has status equal to that of a king. (4) Even a single planet located in exaltation aspacted by its friend, makes the native a king having much wealth-and successful due to cooperation of his friends. On the other hand, if many planets are occupying inimical or debilitation signs the native becomes devoid of wealth, and comforts; foolish, diseased, with no freedom and with a temperament that threatens the life of others. (5) From a perusal of shloka 4 above it would be seen that a planet occupying a friendly sign and in retrogression is almost equal to an exalted planet if not better. Retrogression is thus always a sign of strength.

It is very nice to be born in an Ascendant that has the same Navamsha sign as the sign in the lagra (vargottam). Birth chart having a natural benefic planet in the 2nd house from the Sun (Veshi is 2nd) is also very nice for the native. To have planets in kendras is also a sign of high luck. To have "Karaka" planets in the horoscope is also very nice. When two or more planets are located in their exaltation signs in the cardinal houses and are in kendras. also from each other, they are said to constitute karaka yoga. (6-7) It is easy to understand that a planet in its own sign & Navamsha located in lagna would make the lagna extra strong thereby leading to status, honour, wealth and longevity. A planet in the second house to another planet influences the latter. Obviously, therefore, a natural benefic in the second house to Sun will boost the Sun and thereby increase status denoted by the Sun as a planet & as one of the lagnas. A study of astrology gives us the impression that planets in kendras lend weight to the Ascendant and thereby raise the status of the native. As regards the "Karaka" yoga, the influence of exalted planets mutually boosts still further their strength and thereby leads to affluence & power.
220 The native becomes equal to a king, if Moon occupies the lagna; Jupiter, the 4th house; Venus, the 10th & if Saturn is in its sign of exaltation or its own sign. (9)
The native becomes equal to a king, if benefic planets are located in 10th, 11th, 12th, 1st, 2nd & 3rd houses of the horoscope. (10)

The man becomes equal to a king if in his horoscope, benefic planets are located in kendras and trinal houses and the malefics occupy the 3rd, 6th and the 11th and the lord of the lagna is strong. (11)
If Jupiter is associated with or aspected by Mercury, even the kings obey the native. (12)

When a planet is located in the sign of its debilitation but the lord of the said sign of debilitation or of the sign of its exaltation is located in kendra from the lagna, the native rules over all kings. (13) By the kendra position of the lord of the said debilitation sign, the planet in debilitation will get strengthened, for the planet in 221 kendra will act as a dispositor. The rationale for cancellation of debilitation through the strength of the lord of the exaltation sign is not clear. May be the exaltation sign too acts as the planet by being aspected by the Neecha planet.
If the planet that is lord of the said sign of debilitation is in kendra from both the lagna and the Moon sign, it is obvious, it will be all the more strong & as such would give still better results.
(2) The results stated for the above shloka are so high that we are of the opinion that the house to be benefitted by the location of the debilitated planet should be one of the houses connected with ruling powers. Hence the term "जन्मनि" should in our opinion be interpreted as in the lagna. In that event the strength of the lord of the lagna would make the lagna very strong & would lead to the acquisition of ruling powers.

The luck of the native will be equal to that of a king, if Moon is in a kendra other than the lagna, or is in a trinal house & is aspected by Jupiter & is strong and aspected by Venus. (14) From a study of the various shlokas of this chapter, it would be clear that the strength and excellence of the lagna or its lord is a great factor in the acquisition of ruling powers. Since Moon acts as lagna in astrology, the acquisition of ruling powers as a result of the strength of Moon too is quite appropriate. The horoscope of our prime minister, Shrimati Indira Gandhi is an example to the point. Similarly the lord of chandra lagna i.e. Saturn. aspects its own sign Capricorn, which is also aspected by the strong Jupiter.

Planets which occupy the sign of their debilitation but the Navamsha of their sign of exaltation give fortune as that of a king. On the contrary, planets which occupy the sign of their exaltation but are located in the Navamsha of their sign of debilitation, do not give high results. (15)

If strong planets in their sign of exaltation are located in the 1st 6 houses of the horoscope they boost luck in the first half period of life. Similar planets if located in the houses 7 to 12 give lucky results in the 2nd half of life. If such planets are located in both halves, one gets luck both in the first and the 2nd half period of life. (16)

The total longevity years of the native should be divided into 3 equal parts. The 4 houses from 12th to 3rd stand for the 1st part of life, the next 4 houses i.e. 4th to 7th stand for the 2nd portion of life & the houses 8th to 11th stand for the last portion of life.

If the four houses 12th to 3rd are occupied by natural benefics, they give good results in the early life. In the case of benefics occupying the 2nd & 3rd part good resluts flow in those parts.

In the age division in which there are many malefics, located in their Navamsha of debilitation or are with eclipsed planets, much sorrow is experienced in that portion of the age, particularly there is disfavour from the government. (17 & 19)
If Mercury, Moon and Venus are in kendras and Rahu in the first house, the yoga formed is called "Chandal" yoga. The native of this yoga becomes devoid of character and morality. (20)

If malefic planets are located in the 10th or the 2nd house and are neither associated with nor aspected by benefic planets and if Jupiter is of low type i.e. in bad Navamsha, bad Shashti amsha, bad sign etc the man becomes devoid of good character. (21)

If the lord of the 9th house is located in the 12th house with a malefic planet and if the lord of the lagna is eclipsed by the Sun, the native loses his family. If the lords of the 1st and the 9th houses are neither in association with nor aspected by benefic planets the man loses sons, wealth and wife. (22)

If the 10th house lord is in the 8th, but in its Navamsha of exaltation or that of its friend or in the Paravat amsha, the man is king of kings. (23) The 8th position of the lord of the 10th is bad, but due to the excellent strength derived by the 10th lord from exalted Navamsha etc. the planet on the whole works to the great advantage of the native. (23)
If Saturn is in a kendra & Moon in lagna & Jupiter is in the 12th house, the native, separated from his home, devoid of sons and wife, is without virtues, is foolish and lives on charity. (24)
230 If the lord of the lagna is located in the 5th or 2nd house from Moon & only malefic planets are in the 8th house, the Moon is in the 10th house the native lives by despicable means. (25)

If the malefic planets occupy the 6th, 8th and 12th house from the lord of the lagna, the man has to leave his place of birth. If Jupiter is in the Navamsha of the sign of its debilitation, or in the inimical Navamsha, & Saturn is in the Navamsha of Jupiter, the result follows. (26)
If a native has all the planets in houses 1 to 6, and the lord of the 9th house is in the 2nd with Moon, the native becomes a king. (27)
If the lord of the Navamsa occupied by the lord of the sign occupied by Moon is located in kendra, 11th house or a trinal house or it is in kendra to Mercury. the man becomes king of kings. (28)
If the Sun is located in the 10th degree of Libra, the native loses the nice results of thousands of good yogas in his horoscope. (29) Sun in the 10th degree of Libra is in his extreme debilitation.

Venus located in its sign of debilitation destroys Raj yoga. If at the time of birth there is the fall of a meteor or there is a "Aprkasha" planet, even then the Raj yoga is lost. (For Aprakashak planet see shloka 49 of chapter 1) (30)

If Venus is in its sign of debilitation (6) or it is situated in the Navamsha sign of Saturn, if Moon & Sun are located in the 7th house under aspect of Saturn, the native always serves others. (31) 231

If lagna has a movable sign in it, the lord of the lagna too is in a movable sign & Navamsha. The lord of the 9th is also in movable sign, the native rules in another land. This provision is subject to the condition that there already exists a yoga for being a king. If Moon occupies the amsha called "uttam", Jupiter is not in the Navamsha of its sign of debilitation & the Sun is in benefics Shashti amsha, the native is equal in status to a king. (32-34)

Moon in 10th, Mercury in 7th, Saturn in 2nd gives impairment of a limb & rift with ones own people. If the planets are in the Navamshas of debilitation signs or of inimical signs, the result is more certain. (35)

If Moon occupies the middle portion of the sign Sagittarius i.e. its 5th Navamsha, and is aspected by Saturn & Mars or is associated with them, or if Moon any where in the birth chart is located in the Navamsha of Capricorn, Cancer or Taurus & is aspected by Saturn and Mars, the native suffers from leprosy. (36)

If Moon is with Mandi and is located in Cancer, Aquarius or Scorpio Navamsha the native suffers from belly troubles such as colic. If Moon is in the 4th house in similar conditions and is with a malefic the native has trouble in teeth and throat. (37)

Planets in a king Rajyogas give best results if these are in good houses such as kendras & in good signs such as the sign of their exaltation or their positive sign & in the same type of Navamshas. (38) 226

If Jupiter is with Rahu or Ketu & is aspected by a malefic planet, it creates "Chandal" yoga i.e. a yoga denoting bad character of the native. Similarly, if Jupiter is located with a planet in its sign of debilitation and is located in the Navamsha of its sign of debilitation, the same result follows even if the man is a Brahmin. (1)
Even when Jupiter is located with Rahu, Ketu or Saturn, but is aspected by Venus and Moon, the native even if he be a Shudra, is treated as a Brahmin, effecient in good knowledge. (2)

If Moon occupies Aries & is aspected by Saturn, the native has to beg for his food. If such a Moon is aspected by Mars the man is poor. If Saturn influences by association or aspect the lagna & the Moon, the native is very greedy. (3)

The bad yogas referred to in shloka 3 take place only if there is no influence of benefic planets by association or aspect. If the lord of the lagna be Mars located in a kendra and Saturn is in the lagna without the aspect of a benefic, the native becomes a servant living on charity. (5)

If Moon is located in the 7th house with Saturn & is in between malefics i.e. one malefic is in 6th and the other in 8th house the native suffers from diseases like asthama, consumption, spleen trouble, colic, etc. (6)

If Saturn is located in Veshi i.e. 2nd to the Sun, Moon is in 10th, 227 Mars in 7th one gets his body impaired and if the Sun is in the Navamsha of Cancer & Moon in the Navamsha of Leo, the native gets his body emaciated. (7) Saturn in 2nd to Sun will afflict the Sun i.e. the body & bring about trouble to body. Moon in 10th would have zero directional strength & would suffer a body again. Mars in the 7th aspects the lagna standing for body & therefore, injure it. Sun & Moon in mutual Navamsha would mean that Moon as a lagna would suffer at the hands of the Sun. All of these yogas are harmful to body.

The Sun & Moon in Leo or Cancer reduce the body much. If Sun, Moon, Mars and Saturn occupy respectively the 8th, 6th, 2nd & 12th house, the native loses eyes through the humour of the strongest of the afflicting planet. If Jupiter is in lagna, Mars in 7th, the native gets mental derangement. (9) In the stipulated position Sun, & Moon as planets denoting the right and left eyes & the second and twelfth house representing the same would suffer very much bringing about the eye trouble.

If Saturn is in lagna & Mars in the 7th or in a trine the yoga gives mental derangement, also when Saturn is in the lagna and Sun in the 12th, Moon or Mars in a trine. Such a man may be defective in speech & naughty in nature. (10)
If Sun and Moon are in lagna or a trinal house, or if Saturn and Jupiter are in kendra, the native suffers from mental derangement if the birth has taken place on a Saturday or Tuesday. (11)

228 If Moon and Mercury are located in kendras and are not located in any benefic Navamsha, the native gets mental derangement. (12) Moon suffers as representative of emotions & Mercury as that of intellect. Shock to emotions & intellect results in mental derangement.

If the lord of the 9th occupies the 12th house, and the lord of the 12th is in the 2nd house and there are many malefic planets in the 3rd house. the yoga thus created is Kemadrum i.e. one of poverty. The native takes bad food, is engaged in bad deeds and is adultrous. (13 & 14)

If the lord of the lagna occupies its sign of debilitation & also the debilitation Navamsha and if there are malefic planets in the 6th and the 8th houses & Mandi is in lagna. the native loses his family & is shortlived if there is no benefic aspect on the lord of the lagna. (15)
If all the planets are located in the Navamshas of their debilitation signs or in inimical Navamshas but in houses other than the 10th. the native turns out to be a begger. (16)

If the lord of the lagna is located in the 12th house, the 10th house is occupied by malefics, Mars is with Moon, the native getting underserved bad name, lives away from his home, lives on charity & suffers physically. (17)

If Saturn and Mars are located together in the 6th or 8th house. the native suffers from epilepsy. The same is the result if malefic planets are located in the 6th, 8th and 12th houses and Jupiter is in kendra i.e. paridhianvit. (See shloka 49 chapter 1) (18)

If all malefic planets are located in the 8th house, Moon and Venus are together in kendra, the yoga so formed goes under the name of "Gad" (disease). The native in this yoga suffers from epilepsy. (19)

If the Sun is located in its sign of exaltation but is located in the Navamsha sign of its debilitation, the native suffers from sorrow, is devoid of son & wife & devoid of luck and lives on somehow with difficulty even if a prince. (27)
This yoga will be all the more certain if Sun gets the debilitation in question by his location in the lagna under aspect of malefics. (28)

If the Moon is "Ksheen", is located within 72 degrees from the Sun, Venus is in the 7th, and Saturn in lagna the native lives in tattered clothes and if Saturn in the lagna, Moon in tenth aspected by Venus the man gets imprisoned. (32)

If Moon is in the 12th house, or the Sun is there, Saturn is in a trinal house, the Sun is in 7th or 8th house, the native has defective & small eyes & is diseased; more so if Sun & Moon are located in the Navamshas belonging to their debilitation signs or inimical signs. (33)

If two malefic planets occupy the 5th & the 4th house & if Moon is located in the 6th, 8th or 12th house, the yoga brings about blindness provided Moon is not under the aspect of benefic planets. If it is under such an aspect blindness does not take place. (34)

If Moon occupies Taurus or Cancer and is located with malefics and its enemies or if Moon and Mars are with the Sun & malefic planets & are devoid of benefic aspect, the native has constant trouble and pain in the area of his heart. If Moon & Mars are located in the 7th house, the same result follows. If Saturn located in a kendra aspects Jupiter, Moon & Sun located in lagna, the man has no luck & he is the possessor of stolen property. (39-41)

If the lord of the 9th house is in 12th unaspected by benefics & malefic planets are in kendras, the native is devoid of spiritual knowledge and meditation, he lives on the charity of others, & suffers physically. (42)

If Jupiter is in kendra devoid of any association or aspect of benefic planets, neither the father of the native performed the prescribed samskaras relating to the birth of the native, nor will the native perform the last rites of his father. (43)

If Moon is located in kendra along with Mars or if Moon is within 72 degrees from the Sun & is located in the 4th house & there is a planet in the 8th house, the yoga indicates fear of accident through conveyance. (44)

If the Sun is in the 4th house, aspected by malefics, the yoga indicates excessive heat in the body which goes away after some time. If Moon is located 9th to the Sun the death of the father of the native takes place due to water. (45) If Moon & Sun are located in Pisces and are aspected by malefics, the death of the father takes place through water. If Mars and Rahu are with Saturn in the 4th house, there is fear of death through water for the native himself. (46)

If Venus is located in its sign of debilitation in the 9th house alongwith a malefic & under the aspect of a malefic it proves injurious to teeth. If Venus is located with Rahu, the native loses his ear & if Mars is in the 10th house, it denotes the destruction of children. (47)

If Jupiter or the Sun is located in kendra in its sign of debilization & in company of a malefic, the yoga indicates the destruction of children. If Venus is in kendra with malefics & under malefic aspect or if Venus afflicted is in the 8th house, the native kills animals like cows. (48)

If Moon and Mercury occupy the 10th house & are associated with or under the aspect of malefic planets, are occupying the Navamsha of their debilitation sign & are devoid of benefic aspect, the native is always after killing birds. (49)

If Jupiter is in 8th house with a planet in its debilitation sign, the yoga indicates death by strangling. If Moon is in the 12th house or in the 7th house in company of Venus, the yoga indicates loss of left eye. (50)
If Moon is in a trine with Sun the native's house is infested with poisonous insects. If in this place there is Saturn and Ketu then there is falling of many lizards. (51)

If Rahu is there i.e. in the trinal house, being bitten by dogs is feared, if Mars is there fear comes from tortoise. If Mercury is there the fear of being bitten by flies, if it is Venus there is fear of loss of sleep or there is trouble from women, if it is Saturn there is fear of fall from height. All this should be declared after due consideration of strength and weakness of planets. (52-53)

If Sun is in the 7th house one cohabits with a stirile woman, if Sun is there in the sign of Moon, the cohabitation is with a woman of equal qualification. If it is Mars the sexual act is with a woman in menses or with a stirile woman. If Mercury is there in the 7th house it indicates prostitution or with a woman of low status or one belonging to the trader class. If Jupiter is in the 7th the act is with a Brahmin woman. If it is Venus the act is with a pregnant woman. (54-55) If it is Saturn, Ketu etc the act is with a pregnant woman or a woman of low caste. If it is Rahu in the 7th house the sexual act is with a pregnant woman. If it is Moon the act is with a dark & bent up woman. (These results follow if the planets are in their debilita-tion signs or in inimical sign.) (56)
Such type of sexual acts should also be declared by planets in the 4th house. By Sun etc in the 4th house the type of the house used for the act should be determined. (57)

If it is Sun in the 4th the act is in a jungle; if Moon, it is in the house; if Mars, it is in an uninhabited house; if it is Mercury, it is a pleasure resort; if it is Jupiter, it is in a temple; if it is Venus, it is near watery place; if it is Saturn, in a fort or in a place reclaimed as watery place. (58)

If all the four kendras are occupied by malefic planets, the native has the sexual act with animals. If only three of the kendras are occupied by malefics, the native performs the sexual act like an animal. (59)

If Mars occupies the 7th house the woman has very small sized breasts. If Saturn, Rahu or Ketu is in the 7th she has long breasts. If Sun is there the breasts are hard. If any one of the rest are there in the 7th house the woman has very nice & soft limbs. (60)

If Moon in the 4th house is within 72 degrees from the Sun, the house is old. If she is strong the house is new and pucca. If Saturn, Rahu and Ketu are in the 6th, 8th or 12th the house remains in heated condition. (61)
If the lords of the 2nd and 11th houses are friends of the lord of the lagna, the wealth of the native is used for Gods or Brahamins. (62)
Thus in the Chintamani has been narrated Rajyoga etc & the loss of limbs etc by the learned Vyanketeshan. (63)

Some authors praise the Yogas in astrology; others the Dasa System. They say Dasa System of ruling periods is important for without it even the learned are unable to tell any thing about the span of life. (1)

There are 3 kinds of yogas of longevity: less than 32 years is called short one-from 32 to 70 it is medium & above 70 it is declared as long. The longevity over 100 years is termed as "uttam" or the highest. (2 & 3)
It is not possible to assess the longevity of people till they are of 12 years of age. Upto 12 the life of the young ones should be looked after by Japa, oblations, & medical prescriptions. (4)

Some children die before 12 as a result of the fault of their parents. Some die of cruel planets governing the early age, others die of yogas causing early death. Thus there are 3 types of deaths of young children. (5)
The sound health of children should be seen from the strong planets in their birth charts. The rest should be declared on the basis of yogas. (6)
If the lord of the lagna is enemy of the Sun, one gets short life. If it is neutral, the span of life is also medium. If it is friendly, the span is long. (7)

For people born in yogas giving only short life (see shlokas 2 & 3 anti) death takes place in the dasa of the planet governing the Vipat star (3rd from the tenth star). For those born with medium life it takes place in the "Pratyari" dasa. (8)
People having long span of life die in the dasa of the planet governing the "Vadha" star (7th from that of birth). (9)

The range of longevity should be determined by the use of the rule relating to the 3 types of signs i.e. movable, fixed and common. (10) The shloka refers to the sutras of Jaimini. According to Jemini the signs occupied by the lords of the lagna & that of the 8th house should be seen. If both the planets are located in a movable sign (1, 4, 7, or 10) the native will have "long" life. Also when one of them is in a fixed sign and the other in a common one.
If both the planets are located in a fixed sign (2, 5, 8, or 11) the native gets "short" life; also when one of them is located in a movable sign & the other in a common one.
If both of them occupy a common sign (3, 6, 9, or 12) the native gets "medium" life span. So also if one of the planets occupies a movable sign and the other a fixed one.

The short life is divided into three parts i.e. short, medium & highest. Similarly we have short, medium & highest, in the medium range. (11)

In the long range also we have short, medium & high. Thus there are in all 9 types of ranges. (12)

The 5th dasa (i.e. ruling period), if it be of Mars, brings about death. The 6th dasa, if it be of Jupiter, brings about death. The 4th, if of Saturn; and the 7th, if of Rahu, similarly bring about death. (13)
One suffers physically in the three dasas called Vipat, Pratyari and Vadha. Particularly, when the governing planet involved is aspected by malefics. (14)

A planet situated in its sign of debilitation or in an inimical sign or when it is eclipsed by the Sun & having Vipat, Pratyari or Vadha gives death in its period, particularly, when it is associated with malefics. (15)

Those who are born at a time when there is in the Ascendant the end of a rising sign and the start of another, are likely to lose life early, particularly, when the conjunction points in the Ascendant are associated with or aspected by malefic plaents. (16)
If a person born in Gandantas lives some how as a result of the merits of his parents, he is protector of his community & is possessor of elephants & horses and is rich. (17)

If Sun and Moon occupy the 3rd house of the horoscope and are located there in a malefic sign & are aspected by malefic planets give disease to a male born with this yoga. If it be a female she can survive at the most for a year (i.e. she dies). (18)
If Sun and Mars are located in the 7th house from the Moon or if Mars is in the lagna & Moon in 7th, the child hardly lives for 10 days. (19)
If in the "Udyat" decante in the 7th house the planet involved is a malefic one & a ksheen Moon (i.e. one within 72 degrees from the Sun) is in the lagna, the child dies soon after birth. (20)

If the lord of the lagna is occupying its sign of debilitation, is situated in the 8th house with the Sun, the child survives with much difficulty & if lives it lives in a miserable condition physically. (21) How the weakness of the lagna and its lord leads to short life is illustrated by the horoscope of late Shri Surya Prakash, son of Shri B.V. Raman of the Astrological Magazine, Bangalore. Here the lagna is occupied by a Neecha (debilitated) planet & the lord of the lagna, Venus, is also in its sign of debilitation associated with Mercury the dispositor of malefic Ketu. Moon too standing as one of the lagnas is weak in "Paksha" strength, being within 72 degrees from the Sun & its dispositor, Jupiter afflicted by the 10th aspect of Saturn. The weakness of the lagnas, apart from other defects, led primarily to death at the age of 28.
If all planets are located in Apokrim houses (3rd, 6th, 9th & 12th) devoid of strength, the child lives for 2 or 6 months only. (22)

If at the time of birth of a person there is rise of Ketu (see Upgrahas in shloka 49 & chapter 1) in the east & it falls in the west & there are sounds of fire & winds & there is Raudra (bad) Muhoorta, the person does not live. (23) Raudra Muhoorta is the last half portion of the 90 minutes preceding Sun rise, the earlier half being Brahm Muhoorta.

If one is born at the time of an eclipse of the Sun or the Moon or at the time of "Parivesh" (see upgrahas in shloka 49 chapter 1) associated with malefics & when there is a malefic in the lagna & the lord of the lagna too is weak the native lives for 3 fortnights or 3 months only. (24)
If the lord of the Navamsha in the lagna, the lord of the sign occupied by Moon and the lord of the lagna are all eclipsed by the Sun, the native gets his life terminated within some days. (25)

A person, born at a time when there are 4 types of sandhis or conjunctions & the conjunction points are associated with or aspected by malefics, without the association or aspect of benefics. dies soon after birth. (26) What is one man's food is another man's poison. The rules applicable to spirituality are antithesis of those applicable to material world. In the spiritual realm Samadhi or "Void" is the most desirable and coveted trait for the mind to be in, whereas in the material world "Voids" denote poverty and is a trait mostly to. 241 be shunned. In the world periods denoting turns of roads, seasons, puberty to youth, slavery to freedom are fraught with danger. Thus when the lagna and the Moon are located at turning or junctional points such as the end of one sign and the beginning of another, end of one Nakshatra and beginning of another, end of day and beginning of night, end of one tithi and beginning of another tithi, that period is dangerous to the life of the native.

If Rahu is located in a kendra, in association with or under the aspect of malefics & is not aspected by benefics, the native meets his death soon after birth. If a malefic planet is in kendra & Saturn is in lagna or a trinal house & the benefic planets are located in the 6th, 8th or the 12th house then also the child meets the same fate. (27)

A person born when lagna is occupied by a ksheen Moon (a Moon located within 72 degrees from the Sun) aspected by malefics loses his life soon after birth. Similar is the fate of a person born when Moon occupies the lagna with a sign other than Taurus, Cancer 'or Aries & associated with Rahu. (28)

If the 2nd and the 12th houses from the lagna are occupied by malefics or if there are malefic planets in the 6th and the 8th house the child dies immediately. Or there are malefic planets in the 8th house from the lagna and Moon is ksheen (see shloka 20) the child lives only for 8 years). (29)

If there are malefics in kendras from the Moon & there are no benefics in the kendras, the child dies within a year of birth. If the lord of the sign occupied by Moon is located in lagna with malefics & is aspected by Saturn, the child lives only for 8 years, provided Jupiter does not influence the lagna. (30)

A person born during the conjunction in lagna of two signs dies in the 6th, 12th or the 8th year if he has Moon in his 6th, 8th or 12th house, in a ksheen condition (i.e. within 72 degrees from the Sun) & associated with malefics dies soon after birth. If the Moon is aspected by benefics the child lives for 8 years. If both malefics and benefic aspect the Moon the child lives for 4 years. (31)
If Jupiter is in the sign Libra or Gemini in the lagna conjoined with Venus and Mercury but aspected by malefics or if the malefics are in the 8th house, the native lives only for 8 years. (33)

If a ksheen Moon (within 72 degrees from the Sun) is in the lagna & the 8th house & kendras are occupied by malefics & if Moon is in between malefics & located in the 8th, 4th or 7th house; in such a lagna, if malefics are in the 7th & 8th houses, the child dies along with its mother. if Moon is not aspected by strong benefics. (34)

If Moon is in lagna with Rahu & is associated also with malefic planets & if Mars is in the 8th house, the child dies soon along with its mothers. If Sun is in a similar position as the Moon is with Rahu & afflicted, the child dies soon by weapon or by fall from height. (35)

If Saturn is eclipsed by the Sun in the lagna & Mars is in the 8th house the child dies in the 3rd year of its life. If Moon is eclipsed in lagna with Rahu & aspected by malefics, the child dies in the 8th year of his life. (36)
If Jupiter is located in the 8th house in the sign of Mars & is aspected by Sun, Moon & Saturn & is devoid of the aspect of Venus, the child dies within 3 years of its life. (37)
If a retrograde Saturn is located in the sign of Mars in the 8th, 6th house or in a kendra & is aspected by a strong Mars, the child lives only for 2 years. (38)
If Saturn is in the 7th house or in lagna & Moon is in lagna or in Scorpio & benefic planets are in kendras, the child meets with immediate death according to Yavanacharya. (39)

If Jupiter is in its sign of debilitation or is in the sign of Mars & the birth has taken place at the time of 3 Sandhis i.e conjunction of two houses, of two Lunar dates & of two signs in lagna, the child dies within a month. (40)

If out of the 3 types of Sandhis referred to above, there is one, two or three of them at the time of birth, the child born meets immediate death, but Nandik is of the opinion that if the day of birth is Friday, death does not take place early. (41)

If the birth is in the 6th Lunar day, Sun or Mars is in Lagna, one of the three sandhis is there or maraka yoga is passing, the day is Tuesday, the child meets immediate death. This is modified if Jupiter aspects it. (42)

If the birth is on Tuesday and Mars is located in the Lagna. Moon is ksheen. Lord of lagna is not located either in lagna or kendras Mars is the immediate maraka of this child. So is the case with Saturn. (43)

If moon is located in any of the houses 5th, 7th, 9th, 12th, 1st or the 8th along with malefic planets the yoga indicates immediate death of the child, provided Moon is not associated with or aspected by strong Venus, Mercury or Jupiter. (44)

If kendras have no benefie planet in them & Moon is devoid of aspect by Jupiter or (ii) if Moon, Sun, Mars and Saturn are located respectively in the 1st, 12th, 8th & 9th houses without the aspect of Jupiter or (iii) if a ksheen (weak) Moon occupies 1st 7th or the 8th house, the child dies soon after birth. (45)
If lagna, Moon or the Sun is strong, but kendra are occupied by malefic planets, or if Venus, Sun & Moon are located together in the 8th house or a trine, the child meets early death. (46)
Moon located in the 20th degree of Aries, in the 21st degree of Leo & in the 25th degree of Taurus gives early death. (47)

Similarly, Moon located in the 23rd degree of Scorpio, in the 22nd degree of Cancer, in the 4th degree of Libra, in the 20th degree of Capricorn, in the 1st degree of Virgo, in the 18th degree of Sagittarius, in the 10th degree of Pisces, in the 22nd degree of Gemini, & in the 15th degree of Aquarius at the time of birth gives early death. (48 to 50)
The native dies in the number of years indicated by the death causing degree of Moon as detailed above. (51)

A planet which is enemy of both the lord of the lagna & that of the sign occupied by Moon, if located in lagna, even if it be a natural benefic, causes death through its element it represents (see shloka 78 of chapter 1) (52)
If Mars, Sun & Saturn occupy the 8th house, the native dies within a month of its birth. If Ketu also rises the child dies within two months. (53)

Certain yogas have been given for Rajyoga by Yavanacharya. These yogas are applicable only to people born in a royal family. Being severe in character & impracticable for ordinary people, the child born in such yogas dies soon after birth. (54)
If the Sun located in the 10th house is aspected by malefics & is placed there in the sign of Mars or Moon, & is not under the aspect of benefics leads to early death in childhood. (55)

If there is any of the "Pakshi", "Sarpa", "Pashdhar" decantes in the lagna & these are in association with or aspected by malefics at the time of birth, the child dies within 7 years. (56)

If Sun, Moon, Mars & Jupiter are together in any house in the horoscope the child dies within 5 years of its birth. So also is the case if the four planets Mars, Jupiter, Saturn & Moon or Sun, Saturn, Mars & Moon are in any place together. (57)
If Mercury is with Sun and is not aspected by benefics, the native dies within 11 years from his birth. (58) In the text the word used is दृष्टो which seems to be a misprint. It should be. अदृष्टो

Sun, Saturn & Mars, all located in the lagna or Moon located in the sign of Venus in a ksheen condition (i. e. within 72 degrees from the Sun) & without the aspect of Jupiter destroys the child born, within 7 years. (59)
Mars in kendra eclipsed by Sun & associated with or aspected by Saturn surely kills the newly born within 4 years of its birth. (60)

If Moon is located in the 8th house from the lord of the lagna & is weak in paksha strength is located within 72 degrees from the Sun. & is aspected by all malefics & by none of the benefics, kills the native within 3 years of its birth. (61)

If the lord of the lagna is a natural malefic planet & is situated 12th from the Moon & is aspected by a malefic or if the dispositor of the malefic lord of lagna is located in the Navamsha sign of Moon (Cancer), the child dies by age of 9 years. (62)

If all the natural benefic planets occupy the houses from 4th to the 10th & the malefics occupy the rest of the houses, Rahu in lagna is with or aspected by malefics, the child dies within 5 years of its birth. (63)
Rahu located in the 7th house & aspected by Sun & Moon & without the aspect of any benefic planet kills the child born within 12 years of its birth. (64)
If Rahu is in the sign Aquarius, Scorpio or Leo in the lagna & is aspected by malefics & is neither with nor aspected by Jupiter it sends the native born to death in the 17th year of its life. (65)
A ksheen Moon (i.e. one located within 72 degrees from the Sun) aspected by malefics particularly by Rahu sends the born child to death within days of its birth. (66)

If the lord of the sign occupied by Moon, and the lord of the lagna are located with the Sun in 6th, 8th or 12th house from the lagna without the association or aspect of any benefic planet the native child dies within 12 years of its birth. (67)
If the lord of the lagna is in the 7th house defeated in war by a malefic, the native dies in thrice the number of months or years denoted by the sign in the 7th house. (68)
If Sun, Moon and Mars are situated in the 5th house & are not influenced by any benefic planet, the native dies in its 9th year of life. (69)
If the lord of the lagna occupies the lagna but all the malefic planets occupy the houses from 11th to 3rd, the native dies in the 4th month of its birth. (70)
If Sun is the lord of the sign occupied by Moon, and is located with its Son i.e. with Saturn, in the 8th house from the lagna, the yoga gives death to the native in its 12th year of life. (71) 248

If natural malefics occupy the 6th and the 8th house of the birth chart, devoid of the aspect of the natural benefic planets and if the lord of the lagna is located in any of the apoklim houses (3rd, 6th, 9th or 12th), the child born dies in his 16th year of life. (72)

If the lord of the lagna is in 8th house & the lord of the 8th is in lagna & there are no benefic planets in the 6th or the 12th house, nor is there Jupiter in these (6th or 12th) houses, the native dies in its 18th year of life. (73)
If natural malefics are located in kendras & the Moon is devoid of benefic aspect and is located in 6th or 8th house, the native lives only for 20 years. (74)
If Sun & Jupiter are located in Cancer in lagna & the lord of the 8th house is in kendra, the native child born dies in his 22nd year of life. (75)
If Moon is with Rahu in the 7th or 8th house & Jupiter is in lagna the native dies in its 22nd year of life. (76)
If the lord of the lagna is located in between malefics & is not influenced by any benefic, the native born with the same lagna as that of his father, dies in his 25th year of life. (77)
If Saturn is situated in an inimical sign in the lagna & the benefic planets are all in apoklim (3rd, 6th, 9th & 12th) houses, the native dies in 26th or 27th year of its life. (78)
If Moon is in intimate relation with Saturn (by their exchange of places, mutual aspect etc) and the Sun is in the 8th house, the native born dies in 29th year of life. (79)
If natural malefic planets occupy the 1st, 8th or the 7th house & the natural benefics are not located in any of the kendras, the native dies in the 28th year of his or her life. (80)
If Moon is located in between the lords of the 1st and the 8th houses, and Jupiter is in the 12th house, the child born dies in its 27th or 30th year of life. (81)

If the lord of the 8th house is aspected by Jupiter, the lord of the 8th is a natural malefic aspected by a malefic & the lord of the lagna is located in the 8th house, the native dies in its 28th year of life. (82)
If the lord of the 8th house is in a kendra, or is strong in lagna, the native lives for 30 years only. (83)

If Saturn is located in the sign in the 8th house or is in the Navamsha of the sign in the 8th house and strong malefics occupy the lagna, there are no benefics in the kendras, the man or woman born lives for 30 or 32 years. (84)
If two malefics have exchanged places & one of them is in lagna, & is aspected by malefics & Moon is in 12th house, the native lives for 30 or 32 years. (85) 250

If the lord of the lagna and the 8th house are together in a kendra & there is some planet in the 8th house, the native dies in the 22nd year of life, provided further that the kendras do not contain any benefice planet & contain only malefic ones. (86)
If a ksheen Moon is with the Sun, itself the lord of 8th is in kendra, the 8th house contains a malefic & there is a weak planet in lagna, the native dies in 32nd year of life. (87)
If the lord of the 8th house & the lord of the lagna are together with a malefic planet without the aspect of a benefic, the native dies in its 27th year. (88)

If Moon is located in the 12th house from the lagna along with Mercury & the lord of the 8th house is in kendra with benefic or under the aspect of benefics & Moon is weak, the native lives only for 30 years. (89)

If the lord of the 8th house is located in the 9th, 2nd or the first house and the lord of the lagna is in the 8th house with malefics & under the aspect of malefics the native lives only for 24 years even if aspected also by benefics. (90)
If the lord of the 8th house is in lagna, the lord of the lagna is without strength the native does not live beyond 30 years & only for 30 years. (91)
If both Moon and the lord of the lagna are located in apoklim 251 houses (3rd, 6th, 9th or 12th) & are without strength & aspected by malefics, the native lives only for 30 years. (92)
If Jupiter and Venus are situated in kendra, the lord of the lagna is with a malefic planet in 3rd, 6th, 9th or 12th house, & the birth is at Sun set time, the man lives only for 36 years. (93)
If a weak Sun is located in lagna, in between malefics, in an inimical sign, and is not aspected by benefics, the native lives only for 36 years. (94)
If Mars and Moon are in lagna, and the natural benefic planets are not situated in kendras or in the 8th house, and if Mandi is in lagna, the native lives only for 36 years. (95)
As a result of the experience in the science of astrology, I have gathered the essence of the Shastra for the pleasure of the learned. (96)
Jupiter in the lagna is particularly qualified to destroy the evil result of weak planets, just as even one bowing before Lord Shiva destroys all sin. (1)

If the lord of the lagna is very strong & is associated with and aspected by benefic planets by its location in kendra & is without any malefic aspect, the native is fortunate & lives a long life. (2)
If Moon is lord of the 8th house and is located in the decante of a benefic planet, it protects the long life of the native day & night. (3)
If Moon is farthest away from the Sun, located in the sign or Navamsha of a benefic planet removes all dangers for short life particularly when it is also aspected by Venus. (4)
If out of Jupiter, Venus and Mercury even one is strong and located in a kendra, without the association or aspect of any malefic planet, at once destroys all dangers to short life. (5)
Moon even if located in an inimical sign but occupying the decante of Jupiter, Venus or Mercury, removes dangers to short life just as Lord Vishnu destroys sin. (6) 253

If birth has taken place in the night time in the bright fortnight of the Moon, and Moon is aspected by benefics then even if she is located in 6th or 8th house removes all dangers to short life. Similar is the case if birth is in dark fortnight but during day time & the Moon is aspected by malefics. (7)
If Moon occupies the Navamsha of a benefic planet, is aspected by a benefic. & is farthest away from the Sun, destroys all dangers to short life like Garuda destroying poison. (8)

If Jupiter is located away from the Sun & is in the 10th house it destroys all dangers to short life. If Jupiter, Moon, Venus and Mercury are located in the Navamsha of benefic planets these also destroy all dangers to short life. (9)

If the lord of the lagna is a natural benefic planet & is located in kendra. aspected by benefics it destroys all dangers to short life. If the lord of the lagna be a natural malefic planet but is aspected by benefics located in the Navamsha of their own signs it also destroys all danger to short life. (10)

If Rahu is located in the 3rd or 6th house from the lagna and is free from malefic influence, but has the aspect on it of benefics, destroys all dangers to short life like the strong wind removing away by its strength the huge store of cotton. (11)

If all planets are in sheershodaya signs (i.e. in signs 5, 6, 7, 8, 11 & 3) and occupy the Navamsha of benefic planets remove all danger to short life. Similarly if Moon farthest away from the Sun is under the aspect of benefics but is not under the influence of any malefic by association etc. removes all dangers to short life. (12) 254
If the Moon is farthest away from the Sun and is aspected by all planets, it destroys all dangers to short life like a king pardoning all sins through his compassion. (13)

If natural benefic planets are very strong, & the malefic are weak, the lagna contains the sign of a benefic planet & is aspected by benefics, all dangers to short life are removed, like the mantra pooja of planets removing all sins. (14)
If Agastya (one of the Seven famous stars) rises with Sapta Rishis having Marichi as the first of them, all dangers to life are destroyed like Sun destroying all darkness. (15)
If Rahu is located in lagna in Aries, Taurus or Cancer, it destroys all dangers to short life like a happy king forgiving a criminal. (16)

Moon located in a benefic Varga (decante, Navamsha etc), even if she be ksheen but aspected by benefics removes all dangers to short life like the concoction of bark of Jateephal for removing loose motions. (17)
Natural benefic planets located 6th, 7th & 8th from Moon remove all trouble (of short life) like the amorous movements of the young woman removing all sorrow from the mind of a young man. (18)

If moon is located in the sign of a malefic planet, but is aspected by the lord of the sign occupied by it & is situated in the Navamsha 255 etc of benefic planets, life is protected like the wealth of a miser. (19)
If the lord of the sign occupied by Moon is located in the lagna & is aspected by benefics, including Venus, & Moon is in her exaltation sign all danger to short life is removed. (20)

If Moon is in her sign of exaltation, or is in her own sign, in the varga (Navamsha etc) of benefics, or in its own varga is farthest away from the Sun, is under aspect of benefics, is without the aspect of her enemies, nor associated with or aspected by malefics, she removes all danger to short life like the Sun acting on ice. (21)

(2) Sorrow would result if Jupiter is afflicted. Jupiter is considered in Astrology as the best of benefics, which no doubt it is. But in actual experience it has sometime, though not always failed to act as the benefic planet. We would like to give an example. Here is the birth chart of a boy from the family of the translator of this work. The native died in his 7th or 8th year of life, inspite of its full 5th aspect on lagna. Jupiter is not only in exaltation but is also in retrogression & therefore, should be considered as strong. Then Moon is full. There must be some reason for short life. We do not subscribe to the view that a planet in exaltation but in retrogression acts as a debilitation planet. Here Jupiter is no doubt weak but not for being in retrogression while in exaltation. The reason lies in the fact that Jupiter is fully aspected by an extra malefic Saturn. Saturn aspecting Jupiter was not sufficient to turn Jupiter from a benefic to a malefic but when you consider the fact that Saturn is the dispositor of as many as 3 malefics viz Sun, Mars & Mercury you can at once see the malefic influence of 4 planets on Jupiter. Jupiter is also fully aspected by the 5th aspect of Rahu who in doing so throws on Jupiter the extremely malefic influence of Saturn. During the main ruling period of the Sun located in the Ascendant and the sub periods of Mars, Saturn, Ketu and Rahu, the native gets sorrow & loss of ruling powers, wealth and property. (1) This would be the result when the planets Mars etc. are in "Agochar" position i.e. are ill placed from the Sun & weak. If however, they are in "Gochar" they give good results. (2) A planet in its own sign, in its sign of exaltation, in its friends sign, not eclipsed by the Sun, not situated in the 6th, 8th or 12th house is technically called in gochar. (3) If it is eclipsed, in debilitation sign, and in sign other than its Mool Trikon sign or other than a friends sign & when located in 6th, 8th or 12th house is bad and is technically called "Yam gochar". In the first place (vide shloka 7) it must be remembered that academic education & its extent and quality have to be determined from the 2nd house of the horoscope i.e. through the nature of influence falling on the second house & its lord and its significator (Mercury). Such education is not to be seen from any other house such as the 4th and the 5th as some people do. Secondly, it would be seen that a uniform principle runs through the method of prediction taught by the author. The principle is that the planet, whether a natural malefic or a natural benefic, must be taken as influencing the planet having its main ruling period irrespective of the house occupied by them. In that event, the sub period of Mars located any where will harm the right eye, if sun in the 2nd house is having its main ruling period. In case, where Mars is strong and aspecting also the Sun in the 2nd house, injury to the right eye is a certainty. The reason is that Mars in such a case will have double malefic influence on the factors representing the right eye viz the 2nd house and the planet Sun. As regards the "Gochar sthan" position of the planets having their sub period, we are of the opinion that the benefit or harm to the house occupied by the main dasa lord would be much when the planets having their sub periods are strong. for then their influence. good or bad. will be more effective.

In horoscopes where the nakshatra (asterism) is of increased duration i.e. where it last for 24 hours on the previous day and extends to the next day as well, the native gets health, wealth etc. Similar good results should be declared where tithi (lunar date) etc also extends similarly. (1) In case the tithi etc is of kshaya type with two lunar dates end in a particular date & some part of the 3rd lunar date also starts in that day, the lunar date coming in the middle of the 3 lunar dates is termed as "Kshaya" tithi. It is taken as a malefic tithi.
The longevity etc is short accordingly. The tithi may be kept as a unit, the asterism is tenfold in results & the lagna lakh times more. The integrated results should be taken. (2)

The second decante of Aries, all the three of Gemini, & the first of Leo are known as "Bird" decantes. The 2nd and 3rd decantes of Cancer, the first & 3rd of Scorpio & the 3rd of Pisces are called "व्याला" or serpent decantes. The first decante of Capricorn is called "Nigad" (related to hanging).

Sun, Mars and Saturn are "dry" planets, Moon and Venus are watery, Mercury and Jupiter become watery if associated with watery signs, otherwise they are dry. Aquarius, Cancer, Pisces, Capricorn, Scorpio, Libra are watery signs, other signs are without water. (12-14)

The 9 planets belonging to the 9 asterisms at birth are as under & give results as indicated against each : 1st Sun, heat; 2nd Mercury, lovely face; 3rd Rahu, losses; 4th Jupiter, possession; 5th Ketu, destruction; 6th Moon, fame; 7th Saturn, losses; 8th Venus, dexultation; 9th Mars, death. In this order Sun, Mercury etc come every day.
